repository.name: BiomesOPlenty
repository.description: Minecraft mod that adds over 50 new biomes to the game.

issues.title: 26.1.2 Rose Quartz & Glowworm Silk Cannot be Used as Trim Material
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

The smithing table does not allow you to use Rose Quartz Chunk or Glowworm Silk as a trim material in version 26.1.2 (Fabric). This is the case when using any vanilla armor trims and any vanilla armor piece

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Create an instance of 26.1.2 Minecraft using Fabric Mod Launcher and add Biomes O' Plenty ver. 26.1.2.0.22 (and dependencies). In a new world, attempt to apply Glowworm Silk or Rose Quartz Chunk as a trim material using any armor piece and smithing template.

### Logs

_No response_

### Mod Version

26.1.2.0.22

### Additional information

_No response_

issues.title: minecraft:ocelot registered CREATURE, added as MONSTER in rainforest/rocky_rainforest
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

Detected minecraft:ocelot that was registered with CREATURE mob
category but was added under MONSTER mob category for

issues.title: Dynamic Wanderer advancement based on biome_toggles config
issues.body:
### Overview

When you change the biome_toggles config and restart the game, the Wanderer advancement only checks currently enabled biomes, ignoring the disabled one (including those which already exists in the world before being disabled), instead of always checking all the biomes. And if some biomes are disabled and then re-enabled, the progress of these biomes won't be lost.

### Why would this feature be useful?

Currently, the Wanderer advancement checks all the biomes, no wonder whether some of them are disabled. So disabling biomes can make this advancement impossible to achieve. Tweaking this advancement dynamically based on the config can solve this problem.

issues.title: [1.21.11] Origin Grass crashes when spreading onto Terrain Slabs dirt slabs
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

The server crashes when Origin Grass spreads onto a Terrain Slabs dirt slab on Minecraft 1.21.11.

```text
IllegalArgumentException: Cannot set property ... name=type ...
as it does not exist in Block{biomesoplenty:origin_grass_block}
```

The failing call is Terrain Slabs' `SpreadingSnowyDirtBlockMixin.injectSlabSpreading()`. It applies slab-only properties to the incoming Origin Grass full-block state. I am reporting this here for compatibility tracking as well as to Terrain Slabs; the evidence points to its redirect, and does not show that Origin Grass itself needs a change.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

1. Load BOP with Terrain Slabs 3.3.0 on Fabric 1.21.11.
2. Enter an Origin Valley containing Origin Grass and Terrain Slabs dirt slabs.
3. Let the nearby grass receive random ticks.

The observed full-pack crash happened on seed `-1506920906`, near `-1531 73 1753`. A smaller check would place lit Origin Grass next to dirt slabs and wait for spreading, but that minimal setup has not been independently tested.

### Logs

No external log attachment. The server crash report identifies `SpreadableBlock.randomTick()` calling Terrain Slabs' `injectSlabSpreading()`, then `State.with()` throwing the property error quoted above. The repeated sound-channel errors happened afterward, during shutdown.

### Mod Version

BOP 21.11.0.33 local build, Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.5.

Terrain Slabs 3.3.0, TerraBlender 21.11.0.0 and GlitchCore 21.11.0.4. The local BOP change only adjusts offshore biome placement and does not change Origin Grass.

### Additional information

Terrain Slabs' latest branch already handles unsupported spreadable blocks by returning before applying slab properties, but that guard is missing from its `1.21.11` branch:

https://github.com/Coun7ered/terrain_slabs_multiloader/commit/359f5f985e993ff0af2a9a98946b8ef5c0710804

Backporting that guard appears to be the appropriate fix. It preserves the dirt slab when there is no matching modded grass slab, without adding slab properties to BOP's full block.

Terrain Slabs report: https://github.com/Coun7ered/terrain_slabs_multiloader/issues/52

issues.title: [1.21.11] Origin Valley covers deep water with Terralith and Tectonic
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

Large parts of an Origin Valley region are deep water when using BOP with Terralith and Tectonic on 1.21.11. F3 and the saved chunks both identify the water as `biomesoplenty:origin_valley`, so this is not only a World Preview display issue.

For seed `-1506920906`, saved columns at `(-1600, 1408)` and `(-1536, 1472)` contain water from Y=7 through Y=62 while the biome at Y=64 is Origin Valley. The original player location, `-1641.50 65.06 1347.00`, is near the dry edge of this region.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

1. Use Minecraft 1.21.11 with BOP, TerraBlender, GlitchCore, Terralith 2.6.1 and Tectonic 3.0.19.
2. Create a fresh Overworld with seed `-1506920906`.
3. Inspect `-1600 64 1408`, `-1536 64 1472` and `-1472 64 1536`, comparing terrain and the F3 biome.

These are the steps from the affected full modpack. A controlled minimal-pack A/B has not been completed, so I cannot yet say whether Tectonic is required. World Preview is optional; the mismatch exists in the saved world data.

### Logs

No log attachment. This is a generation mismatch rather than a crash. The saved-block observations and source comparison are included here.

### Mod Version

Biomes O Plenty 21.11.0.32, Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.5.

TerraBlender 21.11.0.0, GlitchCore 21.11.0.4, Terralith 2.6.1 and Tectonic 3.0.19.

### Additional information

`BOPOverworldBiomeBuilder.addOffCoastBiomes()` assigns BOP island biomes across the mushroom-fields continentalness interval `[-1.2, -1.05]` with unrestricted erosion. Terralith 2.6.1 divides that interval into alternating ocean and island bands. Tectonic's Terralith overlay also varies offshore terrain height by erosion.

A local candidate fix detects `terralith:alpha_islands` in the biome registry, covering both the mod and datapack distributions, and splits BOP's offshore entries to match Terralith 2.6.1:

| Erosion interval | Selection |
| --- | --- |
| -1.0 to -0.78 | Temperature-appropriate deep ocean |
| -0.78 to -0.2225 | Existing BOP island selection |
| -0.2225 to 0.05 | Temperature-appropriate deep ocean |
| 0.05 to 0.4 | Existing BOP island selection |
| 0.4 to 0.565 | Temperature-appropriate deep ocean |
| 0.565 to 1.0 | Existing BOP island selection |

Without Terralith, the original placement stays unchanged. This corrects biome selection over submerged terrain; it does not raise the seabed or rewrite old chunks. The intervals are specific to the inspected Terralith 2.6.1 data and should be checked for other versions.

Four local climate-lookup checks pass with the candidate, covering ocean/island bands and unchanged non-Terralith and ordinary inland/ocean entries across all three BOP builders. The ocean case fails on the original code. Fabric assemble passes; the full upstream build separately hits five stale access-widener declarations. An in-game before/after generation comparison remains pending.

Related older report: #1967. That report mentions Terralith and submerged Tropics; this report adds a current-version reproduction and the specific offshore erosion mismatch.

issues.title: Null liquid crashes FogRenderer.setupFog (Vector4f cannot be cast to FogData)
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

`MixinLiquidNullFluid` crashes the game when the camera is near the null liquid, throwing "_Vector4f cannot be cast to FogData_" in `FogRenderer.setupFog` (BOP 26.1.2.0.16).

This looks like the same bug Blood used to have. `MixinBloodFluid` was migrated to return `FogData`, but `MixinLiquidNullFluid` still returns a `Vector4f`, which no longer matches what `setupFog` must return.

The fix should just be making `MixinLiquidNullFluid` return a `FogData` like `MixinBloodFluid` already does.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Get some null liquid (e.g. place it with a bucket or the /fill command).
Submerge yourself fully in the null liquid.

issues.title: Add Proper Sand & Sandstone Tagging
issues.body:
### Overview

Currently, while the BoP sands and sandstones are added to the broad Common tags (`c:sands`, `c:sandstone/blocks`), there's nothing separating them into block sets within those tags, unlike Vanilla blocks.

I would suggest adding all sandstones by color to `c:sandstone/<color>_blocks` and all sands to `c:sands/<color>` to both match the Common tag conventions for Vanilla sands & sandstones.

### Why would this feature be useful?

To be able to more cohesively separate sands & sandstones into distinct block sets.

I can find all Vanilla Red Sandstone blocks with `c:sandstone/red_blocks`, but for BoP I cannot do the same for white, black, or orange sands _or_ sandstones.

issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

Whenever placing hanging signs in the world they cannot be deleted at all.
When trying to remove them (both in creative and survival) they disappear for a moment before reappearing, no other block can be placed in the spot and it will always change into the sign. Nothing seems to get rid of them. 
After closing and opening the game again the sign appears invisible, though the outline of the sign can still be seen. Eventually they reappear after looking at them for a moment or trying to interact with them.
This _doesn't_ effect non hanging/floor signs, _only_ hanging signs.
It _doesn't_ effect vanilla minecraft wood signs (hanging or floor).
You cannot edit or write on the signs at all either.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Placing a hanging sign in any of the biomes o plenty wood and trying to remove it.

### Logs

_No response_

### Mod Version

1.20.1

### Additional information

It happened specifically on a Cobblemon (fabric 1.20.1) server, and there is a long list of other mods aside the two. The only mods that appear to involve signs are Feytweaks and Stendhal. We're unsure if it's compatibility issues with either these or other mods.
Honestly any tips/info would help!

issues.title: Empyreal signs crashing client
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

I upgraded my server and client from 1.21.1 to 1.21.4 three days ago. Prior to that time, I had placed a few empyreal signs to prevent water from flowing out of one space to another (if it matters, they were placed on amethyst blocks in a mystic grove biome).  Today, I returned to that location, and my client crashed immediately.  

After several reloads and a server reboot, I was able to clearly establish that it was happening whenever I was looking towards one of the empyreal signs. Just turning towards it would cause a crash. 

I set up an experiement to confirm it, and it happened immediately upon placing the sign. I had another player on site, facing the opposite direction, who fixed the issue by blowing up the sign with TNT while NOT looking at it (previously rigged via redstone). This problem does not seem to be affecting any other sign types I am aware of (I tested with Spruce, then Umbran, with no consequences).

I was ultimately able to use the /fill command to replace all my empyreal signs with umbran signs, fixing the location in my game, but wanted to report the issue so you can fix the empyreal sign.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Place, or look at an existing, empyreal sign. Will cause a client crash.

### Logs

https://gist.github.com/Bobmcooper/45654295fe3b59972146b1200206a98a.js

### Mod Version

1.21.4-21.4.0.20

### Additional information

Can't say enough how much I thoroughly enjoy Biomes o' Plenty. Thanks for looking into this bug.

issues.title: Game crashes when entering a modded dimension, BOP is the culprit
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

My game crashes every time I enter a modded dimension with Biomes o Plenty installed. It's with any modded dimension, I've tried it with multiple. It's also Biomes O plenty and/or Terrablender because the crash doesn't occur when both mods are removed. GPT says the crash report "indicates an issue during chunk generation or loading, specifically an error where a NullPointerException is thrown. The error message suggests that the problem occurs when attempting to invoke a method on a null object reference (cloned.newUniqueness)."

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Having Biomes O Plenty and any other mod that has a custom, modded dimension. Simply stepping into the portal or loading in the other world immediately crashes the game. The crash doesn't occur when BOP is removed

### Logs

https://gist.github.com/StarZombie/1b42ef1f7aa1cdd9802d62dea68303c4

1.21.1

issues.title: In 1.21.4 the game crashes multiple times due to overlay issues with boats
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

I was downlading mods for minecraft on the version 1.21.4 and whenever I went to launch it it would launch fine, except a little bit after my game crashed due not being able to render an overlay. It’s not been able to render an overlay for the maple chest boat, fir chest boat, and dead chest boat. It says that it failed to create a model for it. I don’t know if this is just me or my computer but I figured I would report it due to it happening multiple times. For reference it’s Exit Code: -1 .
![IMG_3891](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ed2f3d4e-b20b-495d-a5e6-3bb157046aa0)


### How can the issue be reproduced?

Make a mod pack for 1.21.4 minecraft on CurseForge (the app), Search biomesoplenty , download the 1.21.4 version, launch minecraft.

### Logs

https://gist.github.com/Gh0stS0ulX/ff0d950ce4723040dbb6627b7018745e

### Mod Version

1.21.4

### Additional information

I do have other mods installed that relate to world generation. I don’t know if those other mods are what’s causing the issue though because the crash report says that it’s having trouble rendering an overlay for a biomesoplenty item.

issues.body:
### Overview

When a "Huge Lilypad" is destroyed in Creative mode, it incorrectly drops itself as an item. This behavior differs from the standard "Lilypad," which does not drop any items when destroyed in Creative mode. Additionally, the "Huge Lilypad" appears to be split into four smaller parts rather than functioning as a single cohesive block. While this visual splitting may be an intentional design choice or an engine limitation, it creates inconsistency in the visual representation of the block.

### Why would this feature be useful?

More consistency with vanilla

issues.title: Consider creating a tool or app like Chunkbase Biome Finder
issues.body:
### Overview

Chunkbase Biome Finder: https://www.chunkbase.com/apps/biome-finder

The existing biome finder in the mod can give indications of the location of a specific biome, but it cannot provide any global information of the world. I suggest considering to create something like the Chunkbase Biome Finder.

### Why would this feature be useful?

The Chunkbase Biome Finder is so good for the original type of worlds as it acts like a streetmap. I can get the location of a biome and its size easily, I can check things like whether a river goes to my destination, and I can also design my long-distance transportation systems (like railways) refering to the map. It will be nice if these feature can also be found in Biome O' Plenty worlds.

issues.title: Block IDs of vegetation for shaders.
issues.body:
### Overview

Hello!

Most shaders that support the effect of wind on vegetation require you to specify on which blocks (block IDs) to apply this effect. Using BOP with shaders means that vanilla vegetation moves with the wind, but vegetation added by BOP does not. This can be solved by adding the list of BOP IDs in the block.properties files of most shaders.

Is it possible to kindly provide the list of all the block IDs of the mod? otherwise you have to add them one by one by hand inspecting the BOP blocks with F3.

Thank you

### Why would this feature be useful?

Better compatibility with all shaders.

### What's the issue you encountered?

Placing a hanging sign of a non-vanilla wood type causes the game to crash with the following error:
The game crashed whilst unexpected error
Error: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Invalid block entity biomesoplenty:hanging_sign // biomesoplenty.block.HangingSignBlockEntityBOP state at BlockPos{x=-12275, y=71, z=4812}, got Block{biomesoplenty:mahogany_wall_hanging_sign}[facing=north,waterlogged=false]

[crash-2024-08-09_20.05.55-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16568281/crash-2024-08-09_20.05.55-client.txt)


### How can the issue be reproduced?

Place any non-vanilla hanging sign. Likely an incompatibility with another mod.


### Logs

https://gist.github.com/pacificapilot/892c1397c9eac06f8e4d6bf20b95533d

### Mod Version

21.0.0.14

### Additional information

_No response_

issues.title: Black wolves in Ominous Woods
issues.body:
### Overview

I found an Ominous Woods in my world and was surprised to see that the only wolves that spawn there are the standard Pale wolf. I think that they should be changed to the Black wolf to match the environment better.

### Why would this feature be useful?

The white coat of the Pale wolf stands out too much among the Ominous Woods' dark purple foliage, the Black wolf would blend in much better.

issues.title: Biome toggles don't work for End biomes
issues.body: Self-explanatory.  End biomes will still generate if disabled.

issues.title: Maple Leaf Piles are crafted from...themselves?
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

The three decorative Maple Leaf Piles (Red Maple Leaf Pile, Orange Maple Leaf Pile and Yellow Maple Leaf Pile) all have a crafting recipe allowing the user to create them in-game...but the recipe in each case to make 3 leaf piles is...3 of the exact same leaf piles. 
I would presume that the intent was that you could create leaf piles out of leaf blocks. 

I applaud the creation of these decorative blocks, but I'd really like to see them craftable out of the renewable leaf block resource. Presumably, there was intent that this be possible on account of the recipe existing, even if it doesn't make sense.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Gather three of any single color of Maple Leaf Pile.
Go to a crafting table, and place them horizontally.
You will see that the recipe for creating 3 leaf piles is...the exact same 3 leaf piles.

### Logs

_No response_

### Mod Version

1.21.0

### Additional information

_No response_

issues.title: 1.20.4 Request: Carry On Support
issues.body:
### Overview

I'm still playing on 1.20.4....
Carry On is a mod that allows on to move entities around, such as Chest Boats - the problem is that when I tried to move a Redwood Chest Boat around using Carry On, my chest boat had items inside before I picked it up with Carry On - when I placed it back down, the chest boat inventory was deleted. I'm honestly not sure what exactly happened, but that was surprising - and annoying - to find out.

Basically, either support for Carry On or a fix for the Biomes o' Plenty chest boat inventories.

Additionally, could you fix the Chest Boat recipes to use the boats instead of planks (and backport/foreward-port that)?

### Why would this feature be useful?

For the Chest Boat **recipe**, less confusion on how to craft them.

For the Chest Boat **inventory**, I don't know.

issues.title: Tags not properly updated to 1.21
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

As part of 1.21, Mojang changed the directories for various tags to use singular names instead of plural.

Your mod uses tags in one or more of the old directories that was changed! This means those tag files will no longer load in 1.21 unless you update the directories!

The affected directories and their new counterparts are:
* `tags/blocks` -> `tags/block`
* `tags/items` -> `tags/item`
* `tags/entity_types` -> `tags/entity_type`
* `tags/fluids` -> `tags/fluid`
* `tags/game_events` -> `tags/game_event`

Please ensure that any of these that you are using is updated to the new name in all namespaces (including your own, `minecraft`, and `c`).

issues.title: Add option to render all Anomaly blocks as static variants
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

I've been playing BoP for quite some time and hadn't really explored the end yet due to not finding a stronghold.
Yesterday I did, and headed in.

Eventually we came upon the corrupted end biome that was littered with "glitched" holes and liquids, including the weird anomaly block.

From a distance everything was fine, and it looked like a 3x3 cube of animated static.
Then I got closer, and it suddenly turned into a 5x5 cube of, whatever to call it.
The anomaly block flips through ALL the possible blocks in the entire game more or less, and does so very rapidly.
The problem is that the more of those blocks you have, the more demanding it gets when it's constantly at hyper speed changed it's appearance to another block, any block, and it's quick.

Even if I turn my shaders OFF to save on FPS, I still experience very noteable lag when near just 1 of those 4x4-6x6 cubed of anomalies.
Add in 2-5 more of those cubes nearby and... well....
Without shaders I was running 150 fps, with shades I ran at 50 fps.
But when I was close to the anomalies I dropped to 10-30 fps for the NONshaded one, and with shaders on, yeah it was more or less 2-5 fps.

The anomalies are waaay to laggy unless you run a superbeefy computer, and not everyone does that.
Having 1 or 2 of the anomaly blocks is one thing, but spawning several clumps of 4x4 to 7x7 does take a massive hit to fps to the point of almost unplayable, or unplayable if there are multiple clumps nearby.


My suggestion is to either have them spawn in just 1x1 block over those holes...
Or just keep them as they are at far distance, meaning, that animated noise-static, rather than flipping through all the -other- blocks at hyper speed.

(And if you do change them, then please do not -only- make that change for 1.20.6. Many of us stay at 1.20.4 until 1.21 is released) <3

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Just start placing down anomaly-blocks. The more you place down the more it will lag until it becomes unbearable. And in the End biome, they are everywhere.

### What's the issue you encountered?

Hi there. Had an issue last night where my game crashed while in the Nether. No crash log, but I checked my latest.log and I was surprised to find it was over 3GB in size. I had to open it in Firefox because it was too large for either Notepad or Word.

issues.title: Option for each woodset to use vanilla cherry woodset sounds
issues.body:
### Overview

More a minor aesthetic request, but i personally feel that the cherry woodset (logs, planks, doors, trapdoors, fences, fence gates and other related blocks) sounds added in 1.20 far more pleasant to hear than the oak/dark oak/jungle/birch/spruce (that i will call the *"standard"* woodset) sounds. And, unfortunately, its very hard to replace the standard sounds with cherry ones in Resource Packs due to the differences between the sound files (cherry actually have more variants than the standard ones).

So, i suggest adding an optional boolean option, one for each woodset added by BoP, to use the cherry woodset sounds instead of the standard ones.

### Why would this feature be useful?

This would add another aesthetic customization option for BoP users, which can depending of the player taste, align more with modern Mojang's style than the standard sound set provide.

issues.title: Suggestion: Make the smoke from Thermal Calcite Vent work like Campfire smoke
issues.body:
### Overview

Hi! I have a minor suggestion that would help me quite some.
Years ago I build a roman bathhouse, and to simulate the steam I covered the pool-floor with Campfires under the walkable floor. The smoke from campfires can go through 1 block, so I could hide them under the pool-floor and still get the smoke rising from the pool.
The problem? ....the noise.. So many campfires made a lot of noise.

Then I tried out this mod, and found the Hot Springs biome, and stumbled upon the Thermal Calcite Vent block.
Not only is it more silent, it also has a more light-gray smoke, while Campfire is darker, looking more like fire-smoke (which it is).
So this Thermal Calcite Vent would fit excellent in so many places where you want smoke without the crackling firenoise.
And if you're building a steamy sauna or a steamy pool the light gray color of the smoke also fits better.

The problem?
The smoke is blocked by whichever block I put on top.
While the campfire smoke can go through even the most solid blocks, even bedrock (as long as it's 1 block)...
the vent can't even go through a carpet, iron bar, or anything at all placed on top.

### Why would this feature be useful?

So my suggestion is to make the smoke work like the campfire, meaning that it can phase through 1 block that is places right on top of it..

That way we could make steamy places and builds, just as with the campfire, but without the crackling fire-sound, and with lighter smoke color too! :)

Thought? :)

Cheers!

issues.title: Renewable items
issues.body:
### Overview

I went through all the non-renewable items, and want to suggest adding recipes. I tried to keep things easy to implement.

-----------------

**Crafting:**

- 2 rotten flesh + 2 netherrack in a 2x2 = 4 flesh blocks
- Sand + iron nugget = orange sand
- Sand + bone meal = white sand
- Sand + flint = black sand
- 2 blaze powder + 2 netherrack in a 2x2 = 4 brimstone
- 8 brimstone around a fire charge = brimstone fumarole
- 8 rotten flesh around a bucket = blood bucket

**Stonecutter recipes:**

- Flesh block in a stonecutter = porous flesh, flesh tendons, flesh tendons strand, eyebulb, hair, and pus bubble
- Cobweb in a stonecutter = webbing or hanging cobweb
- Brimstone in stonecutter = brimstone bud, brimstone cluster
- Blackstone in stonecutter = blackstone spines

**Bone meal:**
- Applying bone meal to a torchflower, blackstone bulb, cattail, watergrass or reed drops another one as an item like a rose bush
- If a bramble block is not connected to any other bramble, it can grow like a sapling and instantly become one of the fully grown bramble plants that generate during world gen (which means you can use the same worldgen object rather than writing growth code like a chorus plant)
- Applying bone meal to grass in the appropriate biome has a chance to grow shrubs, dead grass, desert grass, dune grass, tundra shrub, clover, sprout, barley and sea oats
(For consistency's sake, if there is a grass-like block, using bone meal on grass should create it. Even shrubs in nether overgrowth biomes - players can bring their own grass.)
- Applying bone meal to glowworm silk causes it to grow down by 1 block


**Other:**
- Rose quartz blocks grow a small rose quartz bud when random ticked. Buds grow 1 size larger when random ticked.
- Killing a spider with bane of arthopods has a chance to drop a spider egg (0.5% per enchantment level)
- Smelting a `<tag:items:forge:storage_blocks/salt>` gives dried salt. This would require another mod like Mekanism to add a salt block, but I can't think of a better mechanic. Some way to get salt from drying the ocean seems way out of scope for BOP.
- Breaking a large clover without shears drops a small clover (applying bone meal to a small clover makes a 2x2 huge clover, so this would make both renewable)

### Why would this feature be useful?

Biomes O Plenty has some nice building blocks, but most of them aren't renewable which makes them difficult to work with at scale. I don't want to dismantle an entire biome to build a black sandstone house.

issues.title: Bricks made of mud
issues.body:
### Overview

Hello. I wanted to upgrade to the new version of minecraft, but I discovered that the "dirt bricks" in the "Biomes O' Plenty" mod are missing. The problem is that I built a lot of these blocks (I liked their appearance). I would like to know why this type of block was removed after version 1.18.2? And is there a possibility to add it?

### Why would this feature be useful?

I don’t know how many players have built with this block, but when they switch to a new version of Minecraft, they (like me) will see holes instead of bricks. It is unlikely that everyone will want to spend many hours converting this type of block into another.

issues.title: Replace oak leaves in bramble features with a dedicated leaf type
issues.body:
### Overview

Replace the oak leaves in the bramble features with a new `Bramble Leaves` block that is identical to oak leaves, but doesn't drop oak saplings.

### Why would this feature be useful?

- Brambles are very much not oak trees, so Jade pointing out that their leaves are oak leaves, and being able to get oak saplings from them, is very odd to me. I feel like it shouldn't be possible to obtain an overworld sapling type from an entirely unrelated plant in the Nether.
- Likewise, looking at brambles and seeing that their leaves are oak leaves makes the feature feel a little unpolished, like a worldgen datapack that has to reuse vanilla blocks instead of a mod. Giving them their own leaves would make the bramble features feel more polished.
- This would also pose an opportunity to make these bramble leaves see brambles as their "logs" and decay when the brambles are removed, just as one expects leaves to do in Minecraft. The current oak leaves are set to `persistent` and do not decay.

issues.title: The case for making Cold Desert not be tagged as forge:is_desert
issues.body:
### Overview

Summary: For better mod and datapack interactions out of the box with all the pale sandy/sandstone structures out there, Cold Desert would be better off not tagged as forge:is_desert.

https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/08384f311b9e8cd810f7afe9f8c42c722e337178/src/main/resources/data/forge/tags/worldgen/biome/is_desert.json#L9

### Why would this feature be useful?

I would like to briefly present my case for this tag removal as I seen lot of users complain about seeing pale sandstone structures in BoP's Cold Desert biome. Biome tags are indeed suppose to be used to make compatibility between mods and datapacks much better but they come with a caveat. 

- Tags are additive. Only supports unions. It does not support intersections or exclusions.
- Structure json files takes a tag for what biomes they spawn in. There is no biome blacklist.

Knowing this, this means that care should be taken that when tagging anything, that not only is the tag usage technically correct but also making sure the actual interactions that will occur also makes sense and best for user experience. In this case, Cold Desert is *technically* a desert but it is not themed at all like vanilla's desert and many other pale desert biome mods out there. What happens is anyone, especially datapacks, using the vanilla structure json system, and using a tag that also includes the forge:is_desert tag inside, now spawn their sandstone structures inside the gravel based Cold Desert. 

This is off-putting to users as the structures does not fit in the biome. Which means users would need to hunt down the tags that each mod and datapack is using for the structures, override the tag with replace set to true, and manually list every desert biome they want. This is painful since again, tags are made to be additive but have poor removal support. 

This is an edge case where I would say, not tagging the Cold Desert as forge:is_desert would actually provide *better* mod/datapack compatibility/interaction out of the box. And if users do want it to be tagged as forge:is_desert for whatever reason, then they can add the biome to the forge tag very easily due to how tags work. 

It also makes more sense this way instead of forcing modders to have to create their own structure json system or fiddle around with forge's weird tag holder json changes that is obtuse and difficult to use. It also helps datapackers that cannot use the forge holder json changes nor make their own structure json types as they aim to be cross modloader compat. I would say it would be better to not force datapackers to have to choose between ditching the forge:is_desert tag due to Cold Desert slipping in and trying to support all other mod's desert biomes. If something seems iffy to include in a tag and might cause many unintended or jarring behaviors, don't tag the object and leave that to the user/modpack maker's choice to add it later if they do want all the unintended effects of tagging something a certain way.

This has been my 2 cents from a perspective of a structure modder and from what I am seeing in the worldgen datapacking community in regards to these biome tags.

issues.title: Cannot generate Biomes properly, only plains
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

When I tried to generate or importing an existing world with Biomes O' Plenty It doesn't generate any other biome than "plains". I tried to check for every setting between server and the mod and MultiverseCore/MyWorlds/ProjectWorlds with a fresh install and doesn't seems to work either.

The problem is between generating chunks with Biomes O' Plenty and any world manager plugin.


 It happens too on older minecraft versions.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

- Installing Spongeforge 1.19 (in dev, it's on discord) or Mohist 1.19 (in dev but [can download officially](https://mohistmc.com/download))

issues.title: Issues with Locating Biomes When Using Optifine
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

There are two components to this issue:
1. Whenever I do the /locate biome command for the tropics or the origin valley biomes, I always get a message that reads "could not find that biome within reasonable difference", no matter how far I teleport or how many new worlds I make.
2. Underground biomes just seem to not generate. Trying to teleport to the spider nest or glowing grotto biomes results in me just appearing stuck in stone. There's nothing there, and I've gone in spectator mode to check.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Download OptiFine HD U H9 for Minecraft 1.19.2 and place it in the mods folder. Use forge version 43.1.1 with it. Start a new world, and do the /locate biome command for the tropics or the origin valley biomes. See if any are available. For the second component of the issue, do the same command for the spider nest/glowing grotto, teleport to the location, and see if it's there.

### Logs

_No response_

### Mod Version

17.1.1.162

### Additional information

I am using OptiFine HD U H9 for 1.19.2 with forge 43.1.1. I've also discovered there is a way around the issue, which is done by first removing OptiFine from the mods folder, loading a world with just forge, logging off, putting OptiFine back in the mods folder, and then rejoining that world. Doing that allows you to view the biomes as they were meant to be viewed.

issues.title: Bring back Chromaflora flower to generate in the Rainbow Hills
issues.body:
### Overview

So the Chromaflora was the rainbow flower that cycles through the rainbow colors that generated in the Promised Land. It looks cool, and I figured what if the flower was brought back for the Rainbow Hills biome?

### Why would this feature be useful?

Because since the flower changes colors, it would match Rainbow Hills perfectly. I feel like Rainbow Hills should have an exclusive flower.

issues.title: Changes to Dead Branches
issues.body:
### Overview

I would like for Dead Branches to: 1.) at the very least have the ability to be placed on any log type 2.) have some method of renewability, likely being dropped from Dead Leaves.

### Why would this feature be useful?

Dead Branches would be more useful for adding detail to builds, custom trees, and for other building stuff. Currently they are really difficult to use in survival due to their rarity (only spawning on naturally generating Dead Trees, with only a few stacks per biome) as well as their strict placing conditions(only being able to be placed on Dead Logs. (It is more than likely possible to make a DataPack that can achieve this same functionality, but creating custom DataPacks always feels cheaty and unfaithful to the mod.)

issues.title: [1.19.2] Make it possible to disable and locate nether biomes
issues.body:
### Overview

For some reason it is not possible to use /locate biome to find nether biomes, nor can you disable them in the config.

### Why would this feature be useful?

For more control over the spawning biomes and to find them when testing.

issues.title: [1.19.2] Flesh tendon Spam in Console
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

While having flesh biome chunks loaded in, we are experiencing massive console spam about flesh tendons. It also crashes the server if we let it spam the error for too long.

Fly around in the nether and find a flesh biome.

issues.title: Generate Bastions
issues.body:
### Overview

I have been playing this mod for a while and I have noticed that I have not seen any bastions in the Biomes O' Plenty mod, I do not know if I am just having terrible luck and it is implemented so if you see this, please tell me.

### Why would this feature be useful?

This feature would make bastions much easier to find in Biomes O' Plenty. It would really make finding a bastion in this mod a whole lot more bearable. No more 48 hour grinding because all of the biomes are modded. Thank you.

issues.title: Biomes O Plenty not working with 1.19 Minecraft server
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

I've created a 1.19 server using Forge and the two most recent downloads of Minecraft, Forge, Terrablender and Biomes O Plenty—we've been working on this for a couple of weeks now. On the client side, the mod loads but in game play, the blocks won't place event though you can access them in the catalog, and the biomes don't populate in the world. In multiplayer on the server, we've been getting numerous error codes that seem to indicate that the server is not reading or recognizing the mod

issues.title: Easier way to get Hellbark Wood
issues.body:
### Overview

(Preferrably) I would like Hellbark Leaves to drop more Hellbark Saplings (Something along the lines of 10-15% No Fortune, 12-17% Fortune I, 15-20% Fortune II, and 20-25% Fortune III); (Not preferred) have some other way of obtaining more Hellbark Saplings/ Hellbark Wood, such as Trading with the Wandering Trader (As every Vanilla Sapling is sold, 5 Emeralds for 1 Sapling, 8 trades until disabled) or Bartering with Piglins (Similar rates to Soulsand/ Nether Bricks, ~8% for 2-8 Hellbark Saplings/ Hellbark Logs); or (unlikely) have Hellbark trees grow bigger or with more Leaves (just to throw out more ideas :P ).

### Why would this feature be useful?

Currently, Hellbark is the only tree in the modpack that when grown, yields a net loss of Saplings. After extensive testing I have concluded that Hellbark trees can grow with 1-13 Hellbark Leaves (median being 6-7). Considering that Hellbark Leaves have the average drop rate for Saplings (5% No Fortune, 6.25% Fortune I, 8.33% Fortune II, 10% Fortune III), you'd expect to get only 1 Hellbark Sapling for every 2 Hellbark trees grown with Fortune III. This makes Hellbark Wood more of a luxury and statistically non-renewable. It is a rather uncommon tree to find among the (single?) biome it spawns in, so even if it remains unrenewable, it is rather tedious to collect lots of. If this is intentional, it is reasonably understandable, considering the dark colour of Hellbark Wood is really nice and rather luxurious. However, it doesn't quite feel in the spirit of the game to have a wood type that isn't renewable. It wouldn't feel out of place to have a tree type with a higher drop rate for Saplings, since in Vanilla, Jungle Leaves have a lower rate for Jungle Saplings.

issues.title: Sapling Pattern Info when hovering over saplings in inventory
issues.body:
### Overview

I was wondering if it would be possible to add some way for players to see sapling pattern info for each tree type in Biomes O' Plenty. I know that, when running Oh The Biomes You'll Go, if you hover over a BYG sapling in your inventory (survival or creative) and hold Ctrl, you can see sapling pattern info for the selected tree type (this also works if you hover over the sapling in JEI/REI). I was just wondering if something like this could be added to Biomes O' Plenty as well.

### Why would this feature be useful?

I think this would be useful because I know I've had problems planting certain tree types, and I've seen other users having trouble too, and being able to see the sapling pattern info for each tree type would tell me if there was actually a bug with one of the trees or if I'm just an idiot planting them wrong.

issues.title: eating up ram
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

i reported this issue to pebblehost because i'm hosting my server on there and something has been maxing out my ram, they believe that biomes o plenty has been eating it all up, i've been playing and exploring on this server for days (since 28th june) until two days ago (8th july)  that i encountered this problem. i've tried everything on the server side to fix this, even upgrade my ram but they said to contact you. the server would just freeze so i don't have any crash reports to give you but i'll provide the logs.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

i would restart my server, my friends and i can join normally until a few seconds later that we get kicked out and it says "timed out" and the ram on the graph provided is just completely maxed out

### Logs

https://mcpaste.io/a1149d5a71499f7c

### Mod Version

17.0.0.136

### Additional information

i was using the 17.0.0.136 version when the ram maxing out happened but someone said to upgrade it to one of the latest versions (17.0.0.141) but it was still doing the same thing

issues.title: A suggestion for BOPOverworldBiomeBuilder class
issues.body:
### Overview

I noticed that the constants in BOPOverworldBiomeBuilder you defined are custom numbers (although they equal to what TerraBlender defines). Could you please change them into `ParameterUtils$xxxx.xxx` instead of using `Parameter.span` directly?
For example, change `BOPOverworldBiomeBuilder.mushroomFieldsContinentalness = Parameter.span(-1.2F, -1.05F);` into `BOPOverworldBiomeBuilder.mushroomFieldsContinentalness = ParameterUtils.Continentalness.MUSHROOM_FIELDS;`, use `this.addMidSlice(biomeRegistry, mapper, ParameterUtils.Weirdness.MID_SLICE_NORMAL_ASCENDING);` instead of `this.addMidSlice(biomeRegistry, mapper, Parameter.span(-1.0F, -0.93333334F));` in addInlandBiomes, change `DEFAULT_DEPTH_RANGE = Parameter.span(0.2F, 0.9F);` into `DEFAULT_DEPTH_RANGE = ParameterUtils.Depth.UNDERGROUND;`, etc.
Some other mods based on TerraBlender may use mixin to modify worldgen constants. The biome generation of BOP will cause problems currently, such as generating villages on the surface of deep ocean or trees under water.

### Why would this feature be useful?

Some other mods based on TerraBlender may use mixin to modify worldgen constants. The current biome generation of BOP will cause problems such as generating villages on the surface of deep ocean or trees under water.

After upgrading my world from BOP 1.17.1 to 1.18, some of my existing BOP Nether biomes mysteriously converted to Overworld biomes (in the code), in my case, plains biomes. What makes it worse is that now Overworld hostile mobs (e.g. Creepers and Zombies) are beginning to spawn in these areas, which makes it really annoying for me in my survival world when I have to place either thousands upon thousands of torches, or constantly watch my back for creepers in the already deadly Nether. See below:

![2022-04-11_16 04 35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/88679967/162779265-7bcafd46-33de-4e2a-90c3-fc08f595fdd0.png)

Open up a world on a BOP 1.17.1 (or below) world (using the BOP world option) and generate chunks in the Nether for BOP biomes. Then quit both the world and Minecraft, and upgrade your BOP version to 1.18 (with correct version of Terra Blender). Then load up Minecraft on the same world, and head to the existing BOP biomes in the Nether. If my issue isn't an isolated case or is due to another problem, then those existing BOP biomes should now either register (in the code, so open the F3 menu) as vanilla Nether biomes, or Overworld biomes, like the plains biome, and if it is the latter, then you should start to see Overworld hostile mobs spawning.

issues.title: Option to Disable Worldgen
issues.body:
### Overview

Hello!

I'm creating a modpack right now that takes place fully underground using a custom datapack. I would to use Biomes o' plenty especially for all the decorative blocks. But currently, I cannot do that due to the dependency of TerraBlender. Terrablender overwrites many of my custom datapack settings such as biomes I have disabled (oceans, beaches) and skybox settings. Would you consider creating a BoP version that has no worldgen associated with it and only the blocks? I'm making this issue on this tracker because there is already a similar issue on the Terrablender tracker.

Thanks for your time!
Darkosto

### Why would this feature be useful?

This would allow devs to use the robust vanilla datapack features to their fullest extent whilst using Biomes o Plenty's blocks.

issues.title: Compatibility with Terralith 2.0 for servers
issues.body:
### Overview

I encountered an issue creating a server with biomes 'o plenty and terralith.

In a single player world it works just fine, but when you create a server with both mods there are only terralith biomes to explore. The biomes 'o plenty content is shown ingame but seems like its been overwritten in some kind for the generated biomes so you can't find any of the BoP biomes. 

### Why would this feature be useful?

Both mods together are the perfect exploring experience in my opinion and with terralith rising in popularity it would be a missed opportunity if you don't jump on the bandwagon.

issues.title: Lang File Boat Entity Name Discrepancy
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

While running a modpack with the Jade mod on 1.16.5, i noticed that boats show up as something like "entity.biomesoplenty.boat" rather than the expected behavior of "Boat". I tested and the same thing happens on 1.18.1,  I dug around in the en_us lang file and found the issue. Boats are marked under "entity.biomesoplenty.boat_bop" when they should be "entity.biomesoplenty.boat"

### How can the issue be reproduced?

issues.title: Using Glow Ink Sac on BoP signs doesn't trigger 'Glow and Behold!' advancement
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

If you use Glow Ink Sac on any of the signs now included in Biomes o' Plenty, it does not trigger the advancement.
I could confirm by revoking the advancement and then use the Glow Ink Sac on any BoP signs that don't have the glowing text.

It turns out that it's due to incorrect tags. The signs are incorrectly tagged as `#biomesoplenty:signs` instead of `#minecraft:signs`

It's an easy fix. Move the `wall_signs.json` and `standing_signs.json` in data.minecraft.tags.blocks. Move `signs.json`  in data.minecraft.tags.items too.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Step 1: Place any BoP signs and put any text.
Step 2: Use Glow Ink Sac on the sign. The text will correctly glow.
Step 3: The advancement doesn't trigger. Checking the advancements, it shows it's still locked.

### Logs

_No response_

### Mod Version

15.0.0.90

### Additional information

It's a minor bug so should be a very easy fix.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Day temperature variation
issues.body:
Spending 3 weeks in a waterpool in a savanna biome in the middle of summer is not really challenging (nor is it fun) because you die easily from heatstrokes (espescially when the savana biome is surrounded by even hotter desert biomes so you don't have anywhere to go). Because the temperature stays the same all day one couldn't do anything (besides sitting in a pool). So I thought why don't you guys implement a day temperature variation in BoP?

A biome in MC has a specific temperature (day temperature) but it is more realistic to also add a basic night temperature. This will be the current temperature when it's midnight. The current temperature gradually goes up (lets say; every hour) and peaks at, lets say, noon or 14:00 (or whatever). Then the current temperature will decline and at midnight the current temperature will be at the basic night temperature (or slightly different with some modifiers or random values). Then it starts all over again...

In biomes with large differences in day and night temperatures, this can present an additional challenge. In very hot biomes, you are forced to go out in the evening or at night because the temperature is bearable (facing a lot of dangerous creatures instead of staying in a waterpool :-) ). In very cold biomes this presents a challenge as the daytime temperature is bearable but for a shorter period of time and you have to complete your tasks faster or plan your tasks over a longer period of time).

This is just a thought and I hope that this will give you guys some ideas for future version..

issues.body:
## Nether Fortress Spawning Bug - Explanation

When in Nether Fortresses, wither skeletons, regular skeletons and blazes never seem to spawn naturally like they usually would. To solidify this as a BOP-exclusive bug (I am not using any other mod), I have visited various fortresses in my world, and this issue has occurred in all of these. When switching to vanilla Minecraft on the exact same world, the issue disappears, and skeletons, wither skeletons and blazes spawn naturally in all of these fortresses.</br>


### How can the issue be reproduced?

Go into a creative BOP Minecraft world, and create a Nether Portal, and enter the Nether. Then, locate the nearest fortress (with commands if needed), and go/teleport to it. Skeletons and wither skeletons should not be present at all (unless in a Soul Sand Valley Biome), and blazes should only be spawning from Blaze spawners. Additionally, load up a creative vanilla Minecraft world, and repeat the steps mentioned above. Skeletons, wither skeletons and Blazes should spawn as normal.

### Mod Version
BOP 1.17.1</br>

issues.title: Config Option to Disable Volcano Particles
issues.body:
## Feature Request

### What feature are you suggesting?

A config option to disable the Basalt Delta style particles in the Volcano biome.

### Why should it be added?

Volcano bases are pretty sweet, even more so given that the Volcano biome is normally somewhat rare. The particles, however, make it very difficult to live there. Even when far below the surface where there's no basalt to be found, the particles are still present. They can be disabled by switching your particle settings to minimal, but this disables many other desirable particles, such as those from other mods. 

Thus, a config option to disable these particles would make it much more pleasant to build in a Volcano biome. It would also naturally fix the strange disconnect of the basalt particles being present when deep underground where no basalt is present.

issues.title: error during load registries event?
Sub Biomes from other mods don't generate in Biomes O Plenty Worlds
issues.body:
## Bug Report


### What's the issue you encountered?
When I was testing generating Biomes O Plenty worlds with other worldgen mods installed (Such as Atmospheric or Environmental) that certain biomes from these mods just never spawned in, no matter how far I explored.  After a bit of research I found that these biomes were sub biomes that generate as a part of their main biomes in these mods. These sub biomes generated correctly in the default world type but are absent in the biomes o plenty world type.  

Some of these mods such as Autumnity also add sub biomes for vanilla biomes too such as Forests and Taigas and these are also absent from the Biomes O Plenty world type but generate normally in the default world type.

![2021-05-05_11 01 32](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/117130274-bd264180-ad97-11eb-9040-eb7a1224184a.png)
![2021-05-05_11 07 27](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/117130407-ee9f0d00-ad97-11eb-92f5-4abeea2d0813.png)
![2021-05-05_10 58 03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/117130432-f6f74800-ad97-11eb-92e9-39cf6117e29a.png)

After Looking at the config files for these specific mods I found that by default their sub-biome weights are set to 0 so that they generate as part of a main biome and not on their own:
![2021-05-05](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/117130918-9fa5a780-ad98-11eb-98d5-b5b745bd3a28.png)
![2021-05-05 (1)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/117130991-bc41df80-ad98-11eb-9953-697602c40e9d.png)

Increasing these biome weights above 0 causes them to generate in a Biomes O Plenty world, but they don't generate as a sub biome in this case and generate as a main biome which is not the intended effect. Plus some sub biomes from these mods don't have a customizable spawn rate at all which makes it impossible for them to generate in a Biomes O Plenty world.

I'm not sure which mod team would be better placed to address this issue, so I'd be happy to make an issue on the respective teams github instead if need be. I know all of the other biome mods mentioned here depend on Abnormals Core so maybe it is something to do with that? Feel free to correct me if I'm wrong.

I know that this is quite a small issue but it would be nice to have it addressed so that these biomes can generate as they were originally intended to by those devs.

### How can the issue be reproduced?
1. Start a new Biomes O Plenty world with Biomes O Plenty, Abnormals Core and at least one of the mods listed below such as Autumnity, Environmental or Atmospheric. 
2. Attempt to locate each biome from the other mods in turn by either exploring or using /locatebiome. 
3. You will find that some of these biomes cannot be found such Dunes Hills or Red spotted Taigas. These are the sub biomes that would generate as part of the other mod's main biomes.
4. Now try to locate these same biomes in a default world type. You will then likely find them easily in the default world type.

### Logs
[latest.log](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/files/6426453/latest.log)


### Mod Versions used in testing
Biomes O Plenty Version: 13.1.0.464
Forge Version: 36.1.16
Abnormals Core: 3.1.1
Abundance: 1.0.5
Atmospheric: 3.1.0
Autumnity: 2.1.1
Bayou Blues: 1.0.4
Environmental: 1.0.0

issues.title: BOP biomes are now changing from updating my modpack. (New biomes spawning over old ones)
issues.body:
## Bug Report

### What's the issue you encountered?

I updated my small modpack (85ish mods) with some new mods. My friends and I are playing this modpack on a forge server and so we updated the modpack for the server too, replacing the config (which was unchanged for BOP) and replacing the mods folder with the new one. The server world stayed the same. Now we have this weird bug where biomes are showing up as other biomes (shown in the screenshot underneath the FTB Chunks map, where the swampy biome is called a cherry grove). Even the nature's compass is showing me biome locations that are obviously not the biomes I have searched for. E.g. I searched for a volcanic plains and it directed me to an already explored alps that generated in the first place. This is happening all over the world and I am not sure what the issue is... I know nothing about coding other than changing a few config details, and so I am hopeful there's a way I can revert something to show the correct biome names again?

### How can the issue be reproduced?

I updated my modpack with 13 new mods (none of which affect biomes) and left the config default. 

-modlist of added mods-

dank storage, construction wand, inventory tweaks, the one probe, torchmaster, useful backpacks, carry on, swing through grass, spartan weaponry, overloaded armour bar, curious elytra, netherite plus, undergarden

### Mod Version
1.16.3

## Bug Report

### What's the issue you encountered?

TerraForged automatically populates worlds with biomes from other mods, Biomes O' Plenty biomes do indeed appear in the Overworld. However, in the Nether, no BoP biomes are shown, even with the `use_bop_nether` option set to true.  

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Launch a server with both TerraForged and Biomes O' Plenty installed, and the level-type set to terraforged. The mod's biomes will correctly show in the Overworld, but not in the Nether.

### Logs

### Mod Version
13.0.0.431

issues.title: Request: Disabling sub-biomes in config, preventing them getting registrated
issues.body:
In the latest BoP version, only standard biomes with weight 0 don't get registrated in the biome index.

When setting sub-biome weights to zero, they still get registrated, blocking their ID from other mod biomes.

Could you please add an option in the config to disable sub-biomes completely (from registration too) or prevent them from getting registered when their weight is set to 0?

Thanks for all your efforts!

issues.title: Reworking the Undergrowth biome
issues.body:
## Feature Request

Hi! I always thought that the Undergrowth is kinda boring, and didn't look very special. Here, I'll propose some changes regarding this biome.

### What feature are you suggesting?

Reworking the Undergrowth biome.

### Why should it be added?

Starting with Hellbark trees. They currently are not actual trees, because of their size and shape, wich more resembles a bush. Their wood currently is kinda hard and boring to obtain, because they only yield **one** log per sapling planted, wich certainly is very unbalanced. They should be changed to resemble a actual tree, and their wood to be easier to farm. Here is a design I made for the new hellbark trees:

![2021-02-03_14 33 27](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106786009-d39fee00-662c-11eb-9c79-87486dd9a93d.png)
You can see that it has more logs than before, with 4 to 5 logs, making their wood much easier to obtain, and it's shape now actually resembles a tree, while still having a small size.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Now going to the old hellbark bushes. They would now be made of Stripped Hellbark Logs and Dead Leaves. I previously made them with unstripped Hellbark Logs, but I thought that the stripped logs look better. I also previously made them with Willow Leaves and Dead Logs, but then I resolved to make it a separate type of bush. Here's the reformulated hellbark bushes:

![2021-02-03_13 51 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106786701-9b4cdf80-662d-11eb-8219-ec4afee880eb.png)
The log is not visible though, but no problem! Here's another picture:

![2021-02-03_14 43 34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106787260-4067b800-662e-11eb-835a-8980a7297e80.png)

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Now is the time of brumble bushes! They currently use Oak Leaves as part of their structure, and I think that they are not a fit for them. **But** ... there's a type os leaves that, like brambles, is red. Wich one in specific is red? Exactly, Maple Leaves! They would now replace the Oak Leaves in brumble bushes, wich certainly fits very whell with them!

![2021-02-03_14 49 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106787962-1cf13d00-662f-11eb-83de-2c63d3f48893.png)
Brambles would also damage other mobs, rather than just the player.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Now, I present to you a new type of bush for the undergrowth biome. They would have Willow Leaves and Dead Logs as part of their structure. They would be small sized, similar to these bushes in biomes such as Shrublands and Bogs. Here are some pictures:

![2021-02-03_14 57 51](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106788872-4e1e3d00-6630-11eb-9d61-1cd22b83f518.png)
![2021-02-03_14 58 04](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106788909-57a7a500-6630-11eb-8fab-c7d3e4be8d84.png)
![2021-02-03_14 58 18](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106788923-5b3b2c00-6630-11eb-92cc-c9a5e1d31489.png)
Previously, I made large sized versions of these, with the same shape of the current hellbark bushes. But I realized that it added a unnecessary amount of green to the biome, so I made them small sized instead.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

You may have noticed that there are Desert Grass in the pictures I posted, right? Whell, this is because they would now generate there! Desert Grass would also be renamed to Dry Grass, so it doesn't get weird to generate there.

![2021-02-03_15 08 36](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106789999-bcafca80-6631-11eb-9190-49076e5407fc.png)

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

There's a block in specif that existed in previous versions. That block was similar to a grass block, a Nether grass block. This block was the Overgrown Netherrack. It would now come back, maybe with a different name, and would generate in small patches, rather than covering the entire biome. Grass, Bushes, Wilted Lyilies and Burning Blossoms would generate above Overgrown Netherrack, and bonemealing it would give you more of them! This would make Wilted Lilies and Burning Blossoms Renewable!

![2021-02-03_13 54 57](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106791273-765b6b00-6633-11eb-80d4-11b2dd04f766.png)
Note that I used actual Grass Blocks to represent Overgrown Netherrack.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Dead trees would also generate there, but without leaves and a smaller size, with a minimum of 3 blocks tall and a maximum of 5 blocks tall.
![2021-02-03_15 26 21](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106791964-5e381b80-6634-11eb-8e42-81e9b454f848.png)

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

And Toadstools? They would generate there as well, like how Red and Brown Mushrooms generate troughout the Nether!

![2021-02-03_15 32 52](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106792816-69d81200-6635-11eb-967c-87997b240141.png)

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Lastly, Fire and Lavafalls would generate very scarcely, and if possible they would never generate there. This is to imply that what allowed this biome to survive was the lack of fire and lava. You know, I like to imagine this biome as the remmants of a former past in the Nether, when flora and fauna thrived there, and that this is the last flora in the Nether. What is still keeping this biome alive however is unknow. Maybe this biome could also be made rarer (the same rarity of Mushroom Fields in Overworld), to make it more special.

Whell, that's it. Here's a image of what this biome might look like with all the proposed changes:

![2021-02-03_15 47 48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77504298/106794178-372f1900-6637-11eb-86a1-6da830ed46d5.png)

issues.title: Massive frame drop/crash when trying to enter redwood forest
issues.body:
I’m running Biomesoplenty with terraforged, optifine, forge, all 1.16.4 latest updates with seus renewed shaders and Patrix resource pack. Also a bunch of other mods so they could be the issue. 

However I have entered tigas and other forests and I get no lower than 50 FPS. I average at about 70 to 80 frames/second. I’m using 10gb of dedicated ram to Minecraft (I know overkill but I use a lot of mods) with an i7 9700k with RTX 2080 super, so a very powerful CPU/GPU combination. But I just found a redwood forest today and for some reason my FPS is a slideshow of 2-4 FPS ultimately crashing my game. My render dis was at 20 so I set it to 15 and it was just as bad. 

I will say I have biome size on terra forge maxed out and it’s still a beta however I’ve been in massive tigas like city sized without massive frame drops and I was only at the redwood forest edge when frame drop and crashes happened. I get redwood is larger but not that much more. 

I already restarted several times testing it out and even reloaded the same seed and went to same redwood forest, same issue. 

I just don’t think my set up can’t handle it. I feel it has to be a mod

issues.title: Biomes O Plenty Fabric Port Maybe???
issues.body:
## Feature Request

I'd like to make a hopefully small request about having a port of Biomes O Plenty for the Fabric mod loader in the future.

### What feature are you suggesting?

Just a Fabric port for Biomes O Plenty.

### Why should it be added?

So people who primarily use Fabric for modpacks and mods like Sodium can have a taste of cherrywood in their modpacks and worlds. At the time of making this, I am not aware if any Biomes O Plenty alternatives for Fabric are already out there. I am just a simple guy who just wants stable framerate and more beautifully designed biomes and new wood variations for a comfy survival experience, as Vanilla Minecraft just isn't cutting it for my empty mind on how to build a good house with the materials I have and odd wood combinations that would look weird. (Pun not intended. Sorry)

And I'm making this request because Optifine 1.16.4 G5 is not working with the most recent Biomes O Plenty update for some reason. And it made me waste about a half hour of my life :(

issues.title: [BUG] BOP sets the End Biome source provider
issues.body:
## Bug Report

I'm attempting to use Better End and BOP together. I'm not here to argue that you should support other mods. I get it, that task list never ends and there's only so much you can do. Just hear me out.

BOP forces the "biome_source" generator to be locked to "minecraft:the_end". (Found in level.dat, using NBTExplorer)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15705306/103444820-707ffd80-4c21-11eb-9539-69ef031c0546.png)

### What's the issue you encountered?

This does cause an incompatibility with any other mod that sets a different source. Much like Better End.

I was just wondering, if it's possible to NOT have BOP set the end biome source, as (unless I'm mistaken) BOP doesn't have end biomes. (There's apparently a spectral garden, but it's not added)

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Install Better End, check NBT, it shows it sets it's own biome source for the end.
Delete World
Install Better End and BOP, and notice that this no longer happens.

A work around is to follow the better end wiki and set it manually, but if I delete the world I'll have to set it again. I did testing with BYG and noticed it does not set the end biome source.

### Logs
N/A

### Mod Version

BiomesOPlenty-1.16.4-13.0.0.425-universal.jar
betterendforge-1.16.4-1.2.0.jar
Forge 35.1.13

issues.title: Select only certain biomes to be generated for a world
issues.body:
## Feature Request

Select only certain biomes to be generated for a world. </br>

### What feature are you suggesting?

Instead of having either all, one, or none, I'd like to be able to choose several and only those several generate, among both vanilla and BOP. </br>

### Why should it be added?

I would like a world filled only with Mountain, Grove, Lavender Fields, Meadow, Rainbow Valley, Origin Island, Flower Island, Ominous Woods, Mystic Woods, and Cherry Blossom Forest. I do not want any deserts or tundra of any kind. I just want me and all my fantasy forests through an entire world, and I'm actually surprised this hasn't been implemented, considering how many biomes there are. People have favourites, and maybe it's excessive to want a world of only my favourites, but it's either that or trying to figure out how to mod BOP into not generating the others, and let's be real, I'd break it. </br>

Generate a save file on 1.16.1 with BOP world generation, save and close the file, update launcher to forge 1.16.4, and open and update the save file.

issues.title: BoP world type breaks dimensions added by mods on dedicated servers
issues.body:
## Bug Report

### What's the issue you encountered?

Dimensions added by other mods (and probably datapacks) are ignored on dedicated servers if the `biomesoplenty` world type is used. This is probably caused by [this](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/96c2b21ea2883646440f7d31b972b1dceec36418/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/world/BOPDimensionType.java#L59-L65) function ignoring all user-added dimensions. This was noticed on ForgeCraft 1.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Install BoP for Minecraft 1.16.3 on a dedicated server together with any mod adding a dimension ([example](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/advanced-mining-dimension)), or a non-mod datapack doing so. Set the world type to `biomesoplenty`. Run `/forge tps` and notice that the dimension is not shown. Launch the same instance with a different world type (e.g. `default`) and notice that the dimension will be shown.  
Related note: Why does the issue template say "recreating your issue with only Biomes O' Plenty installed"? Do you assume that cross-mod issues do not exist? Alternatively: why are the only existing issue templates for "standalone" installations?

### Mod Version
BiomesOPlenty: 1.16.3-12.0.0.408  
Forge: 34.1.23

issues.title: [1.16.3] Biome o Plenty's nether biome provider not using biomes from the dynamic registry
issues.body:
Just a repeat of this issue report of the overworld but this time, it is affecting the nether: https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/issues/1691

Specifically, this line needs to replace the `BiomeUtil::getBiome`  with `biomes::get` as the `biomes` parameter is what contains the correct biomes to use.
https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/96c2b21ea2883646440f7d31b972b1dceec36418/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/world/BOPNetherBiomeProvider.java#L46

As of right now, mods that adds structures to nether biomes such as Repurposed Structures will not be able to be found with the /locate command as the biomes stored in the BoP biome source is not the correct biomes (correct ones are in the registry from the parameter)

That's all lol

[1.16.3] Biome o Plenty's biome provider not using biomes from the dynamic registry (hurts mod compat greatly)
issues.body:
I gotten a bug report that my mod, Repurposed Structures, cannot spawn any structure when BoP is on. I add my structure to biomes using the BiomeLoadEvent like so here:
https://github.com/TelepathicGrunt/RepurposedStructures/blob/c9dc0b052957d40234f5c23ed8e439bb3aa01b1f/src/main/java/com/telepathicgrunt/repurposedstructures/RepurposedStructures.java#L137-L146

However, as I am debugging, it is firing and adding structures to the biomes upon world create. Except when I go to locate, it is going into the biome provider and saying none of the biomes that the biome provider is holding in its list has the structure.

My suspicion is it is this list that is the issue.
https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/1a5742af0fe65ef4926dc63cb77b6f5099dced31/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/world/BOPBiomeProvider.java#L49

This is where this get tricky. There's two biome registries in mc right now. The builtin registry and the dynamic registry. When you register and make biomes by code, you store it in the builtin registry and hold that instance of the biome. However, when you make or enter a world, Minecraft takes the biomes, makes a deep copy of them, and stuffs them into a dynamic registry which then reads datapacks to make even more biomes or overwrite the copied biomes. This dynamic registry of biomes is when the forge biome event is fired I believe and is the place where you want to grab biomes from. The Plains biome you hold in that list in the biome provider is not the same Plains as the one in the the dynamic registry that is in the  Registry<Biome> biomes. 

Ideally, the solution would be to instead, stream the biomes registry passed in and get a list of biomes by feeding it registrykeys/resourcelocations of the biomes you want. It's ugly but that seems to be what needs to be done to make BoP support the BiomeLoadEvent that everyone is using now and also allow datapacks to override biomes properly.

I hope this helps tho!

issues.title: Loot Tables for Harvesting Blocks with Shears to use Forge Shear Tag
issues.body:
## Feature Request

In [Forge Version 31.2.26](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/pull/6765), the forge tag was added for shears. Currenty, Biomes O Plenty directly refers to the minecraft shear item rather than [this tag](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/blob/1.16.x/src/generated/resources/data/forge/tags/items/shears.json). I proposal that this be changed so that modded shears can be used to harvest Biomes O Plenty leaves, barley, reeds, etc. An example of what the updated loot_table can be found [here](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/blob/1.16.x/src/generated/resources/data/minecraft/loot_tables/blocks/acacia_leaves.json). </br>

### Why should it be added?

issues.title: Setting BOP_Nether to False in configs should Iterate through Biome Registry
issues.body:
## Feature Request

Setting BOP_Nether to false within the configs should iterate through the Biome Registry.

### What feature are you suggesting?

Setting BOP_Nether to false looks for a list of all nether biomes via the Biome Registry category NETHER and return the result
to the layers used for the resulting nether generation that takes over. This could result in Vanilla styled Nether generation with
BOP Biomes and other detected Nether Biomes outside of (and including) Vanilla Minecraft when using the BOP World-type.
As to whether or not this would also allow other forms of altering nether generation (akin Better Caves) would be emergent
behavior as the feature is developed.

### Why should it be added?

There are a good number of Forge / Fabric Biome mods that include biomes in the Nether.
However, sometimes the compatibility between BOP and other Biome mods don't exactly play nice in the BOP Nether.
If the BOP_Nether config when set to false would look for other modded nether biomes, including BOP Biomes, 
via the Biome Registry would allow a work around for Nether Biome Compatibility until a proper integration within the
BOP Nether Generation and overall world generation style is established.</br>

## Special Thanks
I would like to thank Corgi Taco for guiding me through iterating the idea in a way that's possible within 1.16.1 before the
move to 1.16.2 that drastically alters the process for creating new biomes.

issues.title: Way to re-add removed biomes
issues.body:
All of the biomes of BoP are incredible. However, many of them have been removed for clear or unclear reasons. 

There should be a way in the config to re-add all of these biomes. By default they should not appear, but if a player really wants they can turn on a biome. 

Some of the biomes that were removed were some of the best biomes in the mod. The Sacred Springs, for example, was like a mediator between the Ominous Woods and the Mystic Grove. The Boneyard, even though it was pointless, was still visually pleasing. A lot of players would really like to see these biomes return, and this would give them a way of getting them back.

issues.title: [1.16.1] Level seed changed on dedicated server upon restart
issues.body:
## Bug Report
### What's the issue you encountered?
When choosing level type 'biomesop' in server.properties, the level seed changes each time you stop and start the server again.
This does _not_ happen when using level type 'default'.
![Chunk borders due to different seed](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6273249/87873508-66937680-c9c2-11ea-969b-04f715688639.png)

This does not happen in single player, however.

### How can the issue be reproduced?
Create a world running on a dedicated server with level type 'biomesop', start the server and check the seed.
After a restart, the seed should be different.
### Logs
I restarted the server and checked the level type each time - this was the result:
`3196599928246603437`
`-915123199654298870`
`2567645657035694714`
### Mod Version
1.16.1-11.0.0.387

**Edit: Temporary workaround**
After creating the world, copy the current seed and paste it in the server.properties file. After a restart, the seed stays the same.

issues.title: [Feature Request] New Signs
issues.body:
## Feature Request

New signs for all the wood types. I have been able to get a working sign tile entity added in my mod and you can! I also saw some other mods even adding more signs. It's truly possible.</br>

### What feature are you suggesting?

Just like how all the vanilla woods have their sign variants, all BoP wood variants can get signs.</br>

### Why should it be added?

Consistency and... ALL the colours! Lots and lots of colours! All the vanilla wood types have signs so it would make sense to have a sign for each wood type.</br>

issues.title: Stripped logs cannot be crafted into stripped wood for BOP tree types.
issues.body:
## Bug Report

I'm assuming this is a bug rather than a feature request as both the stripped logs and stripped wood variants for BOP tree types exist in the inventory in creative mode.</br>

### What's the issue you encountered?

Stripped wood cannot be crafted from stripped logs for the BOP trees. Stripped oak log can be crafted into stripped oak wood with the recipe found at https://minecraft.gamepedia.com/Wood#From_crafting
</br>
Stripped jacaranda logs or stripped willow logs put into the same pattern are not recognised as a crafting recipe as no result is shown in the output box of the crafting table.
</br>

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Start a creative world with forge 1.15.2-31.2.0 and only BOP mod added. Get crafting table from inventory with at least 4 blocks of stripped oak log and stripped jacaranda log. 4 stripped oak logs can be converted to stripped oak wood or oak planks, but stripped jacaranda logs only have the recipe for planks. Manually putting the stripped jacaranda logs on the table doesn't show anything in the ouput box.</br>

### Logs

No logs.</br>

### Mod Version
1.15.2-10.0.0.361</br>
