issues.title: Crash on startup Forge 31.1.95+
issues.body:
## Bug Report

### How can the crash be reproduced?

Start Biomes O' Plenty with forge 31.1.95. The issue has to do with this [commit](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/commit/765da1aca8db4c530d50db8d0578ebb585a6a3f9) or more specifically this [line](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/commit/765da1aca8db4c530d50db8d0578ebb585a6a3f9#diff-4645a22fa8aeb9a905e1bd7b92d6292fR20). SoundEvents are not registered before items so it tries to call `.delegate` on the `null` SoundEvent that Biomes O' Plenty is passing to it. I recommend using the new constructor that takes a supplier so can properly work.

### Crash Report and Logs

Latest.log: https://gist.github.com/pupnewfster/597ea6f522613c8796506f7eb4a3ec50 (with a couple extra mods from me testing something but does not have anything to do with this crash). I am also not including the crash report as an invalid one is produced due to https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/issues/6374

### Mod Version
10.0.0.360
Forge: 31.2.0

issues.title: Worldgen stalls when using LATITUDE on temperature_variation_scheme
issues.body:
### What's the issue you encountered?

_Since nobody replied my questions in Discord, i feel i needed to make those here._

Since BoP got released for 1.15.2 i was attempting to create a world using [these settings on generation.toml](https://paste.dimdev.org/axigepewux.shell), which are similar to the options i've using back on 1.12. But everytime i tried to create a new world on singleplayer, it always got stuck on 100% and never let me join the game. I also tried to do it on a dedicated server and same thing: no players can join the server since it got stalled on 100% and didnt process to accept players.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Basically set generation.toml with [this settings](https://paste.dimdev.org/axigepewux.shell).

### Logs

Watching the log window i cant see any worldgen error, the last line the log outputs when stall is always `preparing spawn area: 100%`. Nothing more appears and i need to kill java process using taskkill (Windows 10 x64).

### Mod Version
It goes back from the first builds of BoP for 1.15.2 and persists on `BiomesOPlenty-1.15.2-10.0.0.357-universal.jar`, Forge 31.1.74.

issues.title: World Generation Halt
issues.body:
## Bug Report

The world stops generating past a fixed distance.

### What's the issue you encountered?

Everything had been correctly installed and showed up in-game. I picked BOP in world options before starting a new single-player map and let it load. Once I started, I thought everything worked because I had all the BOP items available, in my creative inventory. The biome itself was also from the mod, but when I started to move around, I quickly encountered an issue. The world just stopped generating, to a fixed size. I tried again with multiple worlds, but the same issue every time. Upon flying over 'the edge', I am able to look back and see mostly black with different pockets of air beneath the ground as well as mobs.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

Run 'Minecraft' (Forge) 1.15.2 and select 'Play'. Select 'Singleplayer' and then 'Create New World'. In 'World Options' select 'Biomes O' Plenty' as World Type and enable the other options apart from 'Bonus Chest'. Then select 'Done', name the world anything (ie, Test) and choose either Survival or Creative mode. Click 'Create New World' and wait for Minecraft to generate the world.

Once in the game, walk or fly straight forward in any direction. At roughly 100 blocks from spawn, I then have no further world to explore. 
### Logs

I'm new to this, so I'm not entirely sure what to do, regarding Logs.

issues.title: Last 3 or 4 updates makes BOP not load or get this crash
Override default terrain gen settings with config file
issues.body:
I'm using the 1.12.2 version so this may already be implemented in newer versions, but if not then I think you should be able to override the default settings for the BiomesOPlenty terrain generator with a config file. Why? Simple really, this would allow modpack creators to create their own default settings and define the kind of world their pack should be played in without putting any burden on their users. I achieved this myself by making a custom build with the hardcoded values changed to what I want, but I doubt the average modpack creator knows how to do this.

This could also streamline testing scenarios (maybe certain bugs will only show themselves under specific generator settings), as this file or its contents could be sent to you for testing purposes during a bug report.

After seeing how these defaults are handled in the source code this could easily be implemented like this:
in src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/world/BOPWorldSettings.java
replace BOPWorldSettings.setDefault() with code in the flow of:
if [configFile] not exist: generate [configFile] from [hardcodedValues] > use [hardcodedValues]
else: try: load [configValues] from [configFile] > use [configValues]
        ifError: log error > use [hardcodedValues]

issues.title: Nearly Every Update to BOP the Biomes Change in spawn chunks
issues.body:
Sometimes when I add new mods or update the mod itself, the biomes around me change. For example, I settled in a redwood forest, and after two or three updates to the mod, it changed to a rainforest. Yesterday, I was updating the mod again, and the rainforest became overgrown cliffs(??) and the Orchard I was in at the time became a fir clearing, along with these changes, the neighboring Plains biome that cut through a Prarie became an Ominous Woods, and the Prarie became an Oasis, despite being 3000 blocks from the nearest desert. On top of that, using Xaero's World Map I can show you that at the end of my render distance, there is a sharp edge where two biomes meet, showing that one of the biomes used to be complete. The screenshots that follow show this. 
![2020-01-04_10 17 49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59400017/71768475-ccfbf000-2edb-11ea-8cc8-19c545c0d969.png)

In conclusion, this bug isn't necessarily awful, but it is annoying. I like to keep my grass colors and biomes the same, but unfortunately it isn't letting me.

issues.title: Spawned in/bred villagers in BoP biomes always have Plains skin
issues.body:
Despite some BoP biomes having specific village styles generate within them, along with their respective villager skins, any villager that is spawned in outside of inital world generation (such as through breeding, spawn eggs, or /summon) defaults to the Plains style, instead of the style of the villages within those biomes (i.e. Savanna for Outback, Taiga for Maple Woods, Desert for Xeric Shrubland). 

This does not match vanilla behavior; in vanilla, all villagers match the biome's skin, regardless of how they're created; meanwhile in BoP, only the villagers that are spawned with the village during initial world generation match the biome-specific skin. This issue applies to zombie villagers as well.

issues.title: Biome dictionary tags not registered during biome registry event
issues.body:
## Bug Report

### What's the issue you encountered?

Currently, Biomes O' Plenty adds biome dictionary tags during [`FMLCommonSetupEvent`](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/BOP-1.14.x-9.x.x/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/core/BiomesOPlenty.java). While this works, its making things difficult for mod compatibility as there is no event after `FMLCommonSetupEvent` that mods are supposed to use (only a Forge internal event and then server starting events). It would be a lot easier to just register them at the end of the `RegistryEvent.Register<Biome>` event, as nothing delays the tag registration.

One specific effect of this issue is with my mod SimplyTea. At best case, it means randomly my tree feature will not be added to Biomes' O Plenty forest biomes. At worst, it leads to a `ConcurrentModificationException` as seen in elucent/SimplyTea#14. 

### Mod Version

Issue on my side was reported using 1.14.4-9.0.0.253. The crash specifically appears to be based on the number of threads available to loading, but the compatibility issue exists even without the crash.

issues.title: Adding biomesoplenty:double_plant:half=lower/upper to shaders block.properties throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
issues.body:
## Issue Report

### Mod Version
BiomesOPlenty-1.12.2-7.0.1.2439-universal

### What's the issue you encountered?

Adding `biomesoplenty:double_plant:half=lower` or `[..]=upper` to shaders `block.properties` with `double_plant` waving results in an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`.

### How can the issue be reproduced?
Use a shader that supports `double_plant` waving, like Continuum 2.0.2 and change the last two block properties as shown below:
`block.175 = double_plant:half=lower biomesoplenty:double_plant:half=lower`
`block.176 = double_plant:half=upper biomesoplenty:double_plant:half=upper`

### Cause
`biomesoplenty.common.block.BlockBOPDoublePlant.getStateFromMeta(int)` uses binary operations to determine which `Half` of the plant and what `DoublePlantType` the block in question is. Apparently, when using the selector `:half=lower` or `:half=lower` an unexpected value exceeding `8` is passed.

### Solution
Add an upper bound to the result of both binary operations on the `int meta`. I.e. change BlockBOPDoublePlant.java:122 like this:

- Binary logic: `return this.getDefaultState().withProperty(HALF, Half.values()[(meta >> 3) & 1]).withProperty(VARIANT, DoublePlantType.values()[(meta & 7) & 3]);`
- Integer logic: `return this.getDefaultState().withProperty(HALF, Half.values()[Math.max(meta >> 3, 1)]).withProperty(VARIANT, DoublePlantType.values()[Math.max(meta & 7, 3)]);`

Both solutions have been tested and are working.

### Logs

issues.title: better generation of swamps and swamp-like biomes
issues.body:
## Feature Request

In version 1.12.2 every swamp biome and swamp-like biome generate side by side to each other. That's very annoying because you have a very big landscape full of swamp biomes which don't fit together. For example there is a mangrove biome next to a fen biome. Both of them have a very different climate.

### What feature are you suggesting?

Put the mangrove next to jungle biomes as subbiome for jungle and oceans. for example the bayou next to savanna. Fen and bog have cold climates because of that put it to boreal or cold-temperature-biomes.

### Why should it be added?

It's way more realistic and isn't as annoying as the old generator. I know I can change it with config file, but this shouln't be necessary. 
I'm sorry for my bad english. It would be a very cool feature for 1.14. Thanks.

issues.title: BOP conflict with C.O.M.B.A.T.
issues.body:
## Bug Report

The mod C.O.M.B.A.T. prevents Biomes O'Plenty from displaying as a terrain choice when creating a new world.</br>

### What's the issue you encountered?

When I opened issue #1449  I wasn't paying close attention to the other mods I'd been mucking about with, but after further experimentation it appears that something in the mod C.O.M.B.A.T. (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/c-o-m-b-a-t) conflicts with BOP. The problem I described before occurs when that mod is installed, it goes away when it is removed.

I don't think this is actually an issue with your mod, but I thought you should know about the apparent conflict.
</br>

### How can the issue be reproduced?

You can follow the steps I listed in issue #1449 but you have to have the COMBAT mod installed as well.

(This time, before submitting the mod, I deleted all configuration files in the config folder before launching minecraft, to force it to generate default files.)

</br>

issues.title: BOP option not appearing in Terrain type selector
issues.body:
## Bug Report

Biomes O'Plenty doesn't appear as an option in the World Type Selector when generating a new world.</br>

### What's the issue you encountered?

The latest release of Biomes O'Plenty (1.14.4-0.0.222) does not provide a BOP option in the world type selector when you are generating a new world. Also, when selecting a new world with the Default setting the game crashes. This behavior disappears when I revert to 1.14.4-0.0.0.212 </br>

### How can the issue be reproduced?

1. Select Create New World

2. Select More World Options...

3. Click on World Type to cycle through all the terrain options.

Biomes O'Plenty will not appear as an option.

</br>

### Mod Version
1.14.4-0.0.0.222</br>

issues.title: BOP world type does not generate modded biomes like in 1.12.2
issues.body:
## Bug Report

### What's the issue you encountered?

BOP world type does not generate modded biomes like it did in 1.12.2.

### How can the issue be reproduced?

For 1.12.2:
* BiomesOPlenty-1.12.2-7.0.1.2439
* [Traverse-1.12.2-1.6.0-69](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/traverse-legacy)
* [Redwoods-1.12-1.2.1](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/redwoods)
* [Nature's Compass](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/natures-compass) to find biomes

Generated a BOP world, and the compass could find several of the biomes from those other mods (like Mini Jungle or Redwood Forest (the one with the Redwoods trees, it could also find one with the BOP ones)), which all generated alongside the BOP biomes.

For 1.14.4:
* BiomesOPlenty-1.14.4-9.0.0.195
* [Voyage-1.0.0](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/voyage)
* [LocateBiome](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/locatebiome) to find biomes (there's a fabric and a forge version)

Generated a BOP world again. The `locatebiome` command found BOP biomes fine but could not find any single Voyage biome (the ones whose registry name starts with `voyage:`) within the 2 minutes timeout.

issues.title: Client particles are created with server world instance
issues.body:
[Relevant issue on Phosphor's issue tracker where this was discovered.](https://gitea.gildedgames.com/jellysquid/Phosphor/issues/2)

To summarize the discovery in that thread, BOP's sided proxy is being used to spawn particles on the client from the server, which causes particles to be instantiated with the server's world object. This is incredibly bad for a number of reasons, but primarily because it allows the client thread to mutate data belonging to the server thread, which in this case causes a myriad of horrible things to happen inside Phosphor.

The sided proxy method where these particles are being spawned can be found [here](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/51aeb6cf437e8e728315077d568405f97dd42d4d/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/core/ClientProxy.java#L196).

This is likely the cause of #1293, #1350, #1326, and #1305.

issues.title: Missing "dye" ore dictionary registration
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:
On a large modpack, about 33% recipes are missing with Biome's O Plenty dyes. This includes notably recipes for WarpDrive tools, ThermalInnovation Injector, ThermalInnovation Quiver, ThermalExpansion Satchel, Capacitor & Reservoir, etc.

This is due to dies being only registered for their color in the ore dictionary. They should also be registered to the generic 'dye' ore dictionary.

#### Steps to reproduce:
1. add a mod that shows ores registration, for example CraftTweaker (use the `/ct hand` command) or EnderIO (check tooltip while item is in inventory).
2. check vanilla dies, observe how they have 2 ores registered: "dyeXXX" and "dye", where XXX is the related color for that dye.
3. check Biomes'o plenty dies, observe how they only 1 ore registered: "dyeXXX", where XXX is the related color for that dye.

issues.body:
#### Issue Description:
There is a rather strange incompatibility with Aether II on the most recent versions as of 12/12/2018
Most recent versions of all things involved used

When you attempt to create a new world with the Biomes O' Plenty world type, the game will, instead of getting the world, get stuck on a screen that looks like this: http://prntscr.com/ltx2rn

The only way out is to close it out manually using the X, because it doesn't count as not responding. Usually the launcher would say the game crashed, however what happens in this case is much more strange: Every program will act as if Minecraft is still open, even though its been closed. The launcher will say the games already running, modifying files in the directory will say its being used in Java TM Platform binary, even though the game is closed. I checked the task manager and it doesn't show up there either. The only way to fix it is to restart your computer!
Because of the lack of a crash report, I cant send any technical information other than the screenshot. I also double checked, and it wasn't Orbis API either, (A mod that is required for Aether II to work)
#### Steps to reproduce:

1. Install Orbis API (Dependancy of Aether II), Biomes O Plenty, and Aether II.
2. Run minecraft

issues.title: [Feature Request] Generation and compatibility issues with Mystcraft 1.12.2
issues.body:
#### Issue Description: 
Mystcraft recently updated to 1.12.2 and while it functions properly on earlier versions, (1.7.10 for instance), the 1.12.2 versions of Biomes O Plenty and Mystcraft seem to not want to generate BiomesOPlenty biomes properly in Ages, nor does BiomesOPlenty plantlife obey Mystcraft's custom Grass colors, examples provided in screenshots below.

I've been asked by XCompwiz to direct any of the devs towards this Mystcraft Github Issue, and hopefully sort out the incompatibility: [#293](https://github.com/XCompWiz/Mystcraft-Issues/issues/293)

XCompwiz currently believes the generation issue may be related to BiomesOPlenty restricting biome generation to its own custom world type, and entering the dimension causes this to appear in the log:

> [15:52:06] [main/INFO]: [biomesoplenty.common.world.BiomeProviderBOP:<init>:61]: settings for world: 
[15:52:06] [main/INFO]: [biomesoplenty.common.world.BiomeProviderBOP:initialLandAndSeaLayer:93]: Setting up landmass VANILLA

It should be noted that this effect occurs regardless of the Overworld world type selected, even setting the world type to BiomesOPlenty does not fix this generation issue upon entering an Age.

The Custom Grass color in Ages is usually specified by the Age "Grammar" however unlike vanilla grass, BiomesOPlenty grasses only seem to obey their specific biome colors, ignoring the Mystcraft's custom colors.

#### Steps to reproduce:

1. Create any Mystcraft age using BiomesOPlenty "Biome Pages"
2. Place the pages into a Book Binder with Leather and a Link Panel Page.
3. Enter the Age by left clicking on the Linking Panel of the completed Descriptive Book.

#### Additional Information:

- fml-client-latest.log or fml-server-latest.log:
[latest.log](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/files/2237365/latest.log)
- Screenshots:
![2018-07-21_00 08 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39707481/43032679-40182c1c-8c7a-11e8-9f83-a4a68d2a9380.png)

issues.title: Gems are not supported by Just Enough Resources (JEI addon)
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

When inspecting a Vanilla ore/resource (Diamond Ore, Emerald, etc.) with Just Enough Items (w/ Just Enough Resources), it shows where to obtain such ore (biomes, world type, y-levels and what yield you'll get). However, Biomes O' Plenty does not support this feature for its unique biome gems.

1. Install Just Enough Items
2. Install Just Enough Resources
3. Press 'R' (or configured method) to view how to obtain a gem from Biomes O' Plenty

- **Biomes O' Plenty**: 7.0.1.2384

issues.title: [Suggestion] Dedicated GUI
issues.body:
I just wanted to drop by and maybe leave an useful information and idea for future development.

I'm a big fan of BoP as it has always been the best world generator out there but today I stumbled upon [this](http://openterraingen.wikia.com/wiki/OTGEdit) ([curse link](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/otgedit-gui-for-openterraingenerator-terraincontrol-and-minecraft-worlds-mod)) and it is a very well built GUI for custom world generation. Since more and more people are getting into modded minecraft such user friendly (aka _noob friendly_  😄) application is a game changer imho in the modded MC ecosystem.

issues.title: Suggestion: Leaves, and koru
issues.body:
As always, this is a favorite mod of our community - thank you so much for the work and love you put into it. We play with the Quark mod that gives us even more vibrant biomes which we love and are used to.

It is autumn (fall) in New Zealand now, and our equivalent of maple leaves are beautiful and when it isn't raining there are huge piles of leaves where the wind catches and pushes them against walls.

I love using the existing leaves and dead leaves ground items. Could I suggest having a layerable item like snow layers? It would be good to leave it as a transparent / block you can walk through, although I can see people asking for the pile to collapse if it got too tall. It could be a rare spawn within a orchid, boreal, and seasonal forest biomes. If there was a way to turn leave blocks into leaf layers (skin the layers model), would be great for other biomes too.

We are constanly impressed with kiwi inclusions to mods. Love the koru flora 💚 many of our ferns (and thus koru) are grown from 'fern trees' typically called ponga such as our silver fern. We end up with a biome of lush undergrowth combined with head-height canopy of fern arches. I would love for people to have a squiz at our fern flora and forest for inspiration (such as https://youtu.be/NUsZhZff-7w)

Thank you! And looking forward to future updates (and any End biomes)

issues.title: [Enhancement Request] Standardized Models/Textures
issues.body:
I would like to suggest that a great many of the textures used in Biomes O Plenty are unnecessary. Many of the desired visuals can simply be made using the existing default textures from minecraft using a bit more clever models.

A few examples:
- loamy could be easily achieved as an overlay to the existing grass/podzol/dirt/snow
- bush or shrub can be easily made by combining deadbush as stem and up-side-down double_plant_fern_top or other plant textures as leaves.
- berry bush can just be a copy of bush or shrub with several small cross pattern items/apple or items/beetroot attached to it

Of course there are many things in BoP that require their own textures, but for those that do not, it would be nice if it used the existing minecraft textures wherever possible so that any given texture pack would mostly look right with BoP by default without needing customized art.

Some considerations could also be made for removing some of the models/textures completely. For example, the very definition of Podzol is "the typical soils of coniferous, or boreal forests. They are also the typical soils of eucalypt forests and heathlands in southern Australia."

issues.body:
BOP needs more types of quicksand in the next release to match the types of quicksand found in reallife... take a look at the more fun quicksand mod for some inspiration...

- [] to get started mud should become thick mud that would be a type of slow sucking quicksand you can't sink very far in...

something i just randomly thought of

- [ ] randomly generated quicksand sign (a randomly generated "danger quicksand" sign found near quicksand area's sometimes)

![sign jpg size-custom-crop 0x650](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11165643/38224985-b5936dc2-36c0-11e8-841c-687fc7c7e352.jpg)

here are some suggestions for types of quicksand

- [ ] beach quicksand (found in large amounts on beaches around water like in real life)
- [ ] dry quicksand (found in deserts, sucks you under very fast)
- [ ] soft quicksand (not entirely wet quicksand, found in jungles and forests sometimes, sucks you under at a fast speed)
- [ ] Crustified Quicksand (various types of quicksand like clay or mud that have dried on surface and surface is safe to walk on, but jump on it and you will go through and start sinking, based on hardened clay from MFQM)
- [ ] brown and grey wet clays (thick clay based quicksand that is sticky and slow to sink in)
- [ ] wet peat (found in bogs and wetlands, slow to suck you under)
- [ ] liquid peat (found in middle of bogs, nearly liquid with consistency of soup, fast to suck you under)
- [ ] liquid bog (liquid found under surface of bogs, no visibility and slightly thicker than water)
- [ ] bog surface (plants growing on surface of bog, jump on it too hard and you fall in and it becomes quicksand or jump into a area with a hole and you will fall in)
- [ ] sinking silt (gooey like quicksand made of all silt that is sometimes found in random locations like deserts, quarries, beaches, wetlands etc. sucks fast,)
- [ ] quarry mud (soup like mud found in quarries, mesa's, deserts etc. with liquid like consistency. sucks very fast.)
- [ ] bubbling mud (thin grey clay with consistency near water, bubbles due to volcanic heat, may be too hot to swim in)
- [ ] swamp roots (roots floating on a swamp like a bog, easy to get tangled if jumped on too hard and becomes like quicksand)
- [ ] tar (very thick sticky quicksand, flammable, so sticky that it is impossible to escape from, poisonous)

issues.title: Suggestion/Enhancement: Config Option/Kill Switch to disable all world generation/biomes so BoP can be used as a resource pack for OTG/other terrain generators.
issues.body:
I would love to use Biomes O Plenty as a resource pack for my own modpack.
I want to use Open Terrain Generator as the Dimension Generator.
Unfortunately even when using a world.json file in config/biomesoplenty and disabling all generation options, disabling all biomes in biome_ids.json and in the default biomes folder removing all the generator options. Somehow BoP still generates grasses, roots, flowers (clover, ...)

See Gist for config and minecraft log:
https://gist.github.com/Guinaro/5c3fe3d31b37d245bd74db7f632ccc9b

Open Terrain Generator allows for much more control over the look of your Biomes. BoP is great for those not wanting to meddle with configuration of biomes. However as of now, it still likes to throw a wrench in the workings of OTG. OTG even warns not to use BoP. If we had one big kill switch to disable all the world generator options of BoP (including biomes) that works at all times. OTG Modmakers could nicely integrate all of the wonderful grasses, flower, roots, trees, ores, ... into a custom configuration. 

Tested with:
Minecraft: 1.12.2
Forge: 14.23.2.2632
BoP: BiomesOPlenty-1.12.2-7.0.1.2334-universal
OTG: 1.12.2 v6

Thank you for taking this under consideration. Both BoP and OTG are great mods, if I can I would love to add/integrate them in my modpack.

Guinaro

issues.title: Leaves on huge flowering oak trees decay immediately
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

Oak leaves (seemingly both the vanilla version and the mod's flowering version) on large BOP trees start decaying immediately upon generation. This has been observed in large trees at least in the Orchard, Sacred Springs, Mystic Groove and Seasonal Forest biomes (I guess it just affects all large flowering oak trees), as well as in the oak scrubs that cover the ground in the Overgrown Cliffs biome.

This doesn't seem to happen with either vanilla huge oak tress or other big trees from the mod. As far as I can tell from looking around in F3 (although I might be wrong), this is because most foliage blocks in flowering oak trees generate with the "check decay" property set to true, while in all other types of trees they are usually set to false.

#### Steps to reproduce:

1. Create a BOP world
2. /bop tpbiome to Orchard or any other biome with large trees that use oak leaves
3. Observe as nearby foliage slowly gets thinner and the scenery around you slowly gets sadder

issues.title: Nether biomes decorate without restriction leading to OOB
issues.body:
Nether biome decorators have no y-level or block replacement restrictions leading to players being able to go out-of-bounds on top of the world, and also to decorations being placed on top of the roof bedrock layer (mushrooms, etc..).

This issue goes back to when the Nether biomes were readded in 1.11 (reproduced).

Solution:
For y>127 decorations, such as mushrooms, there should be a y-level restriction made that will prevent decorations above y>127.
For lava pools, a check can be made of the block being replaced and not replace it if it's `Blocks.BEDROCK`.
Or, a y-level restriction could be made that prevents any decorations above y=122, which should cover everything.

This is above the Nether roof. Players can dig up through the netherrack on top of the world if the lava pools go deep enough:
![2017-11-14_09 39 53](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8453133/32795160-e5e9f5ae-c938-11e7-94ef-c58d16c65298.png)

Some netherrack that has apparently erroneously replaced bedrock in the roof (leading to possible OOB), and also some mushrooms:
![2017-11-14_09 41 40](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8453133/32795179-f43c90b2-c938-11e7-969a-a1e77a7742e9.png)

issues.title: Replace numerical with alphabetical ids in tpbiome command
issues.body:
Hi,

I have a small feature request for Biomes O' Plenty. The request isn't very significant nor overly complex (too my knowledge). I hope that you take it into consideration. 

#### Request Description

When typing the `/biomesop tpbiome <id>` command you must specify a numerical biome ID. Currently in 1.12.2 this is fairly difficult as to find the ids you must check the `.minecraft/config/biomesoplenty/biome_ids.json` for Biomes O' Plenty's biome ids and the Minecraft Wiki for its biome ids. In recent versions of Minecraft commands have started to remove the use of numerical ids in favour for alphabetical ones e.g. `/give` or `/effect`. I feel being able to specify these alphabetical ids would make the command a lot more user friendly and be a better overall user experience.

#### Example

Lets say you wanted to teleport to an ocean biome from Minecraft. You would normally type `/biomesop tpbiome 0`. However, if this was changed it would look like `/biomesop tpbiome minecraft:ocean`

For another example lets take a biome from Biomes O' Plenty. Previously if you wanted to teleport a Volcanic Island biome you would type `/biomesop tpbiome 102`. Again, if this were changed it would be `/biomesop tpbiome biomesoplenty:volcanic_island` 

Also, the ability to use the TAB completion feature available in the game would further improve the user experience for it too.

issues.title: BOP grass returning no OreDict IDs when queried
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:
When I use JEI or Actually Additions to query BOP grass's oreDict entries, I see they are oreDicted as "grass" (as expected).
When I use OreDictionary.getOreIDs() to query a biomesoplenty:grass block, I get an empty array of integers, which means it has no known oreDict entries. This is unexpected. I have tested this with all the BOP grass types, same result on each type.

**Expected behavior**: I get the oredictEntry ID for "grass", which is 57 in my setup). 

When tested with minecraft:grass, Actually Additions, JEI, and OreDictionary.getOreIDs() all identify it as "grass" (as expected)
When tested with minecraft:dirt and biomesoplenty:dirt, Actually Additions, JEI, and OreDictionary.getOreIDs() all identify it as "dirt" (as expected).
When tested with minecraft:sand, biomesoplenty:white_sand, , Actually Additions, JEI, and OreDictionary.getOreIDs() all identify it as "sand" (As expected).

None of the coarse dirts, overgrown stone, or overgrown netherrack identify as dirt or grass (or indeed stone or netherrack), via any of the above methods. That seems correct.

#### Steps to reproduce:

1. Installed:
one of Forge 2387 or 2426
Actually Additions (optional, used to cross-check oreDict entries)
BOP build 2291
JEI 4.7.2.77 (optional, used to cross-check oreDict entries again)
Dev build of Pam's Harvestcraft 12a fork at https://github.com/Syndaryl/harvestcraft-1.12-jsonfix branch crop-bop-compatibility
2. Launch Minecraft
3. Create a new flat world, place down a BOP grass block, a BOP dirt block, and a BOP white sand. Also place down a minecraft grass block, minecraft dirt block, and a minecraft sand (or red sand).
4. give yourself a harvestcraft:windygarden and a harvestcraft:aridgarden
5. try to place each garden on each block type
6. check your minecraft log for the data dump, see BlockBaseGarden.java in repository for relevant code (lines 134+, checkSoilBlock() ).

#### Additional Information:

I'm updating Harvestcraft so it does what Pam wanted, *and* handles mod added blocks a bit better. The way I'm going about it may be bass ackwards, but it's turned up this weirdness.

issues.title: Game crash- BiomesOPlenty and AbyssaCraft .. newest version issue
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:
if you try and run AbyssalCraft and BiomesOPlenty, causes the game to crash during game loading process. This wasn't an issue in versions BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.1.0.2238, only presented its self in versions BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.1.0.2239 and BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.1.0.2240.

tried loading game with only these 2 mods, still fails.
failing on both single player and server.

I thought it might be considered an AbyssalCraft bug, but seeing as the version of BiomesOPlenty changed, and AbyssalCraft didn't, points to changes in BiomesOPlenty that is causing the issue.

#### Steps to reproduce:

1. load AbyssalCraft-1.11.2-1.9.4-pre-3  and BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.1.0.2239
2. game crashes on loading mods, prior to start of the game.

issues.title: Creating a world with a disabled biome causes a crash on world load
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

Attempting to create a world with a disabled biome causes a crash. I specifically disabled the alps biome.

#### Steps to reproduce:

1. Disable the alps biomes by setting its ID to -1.
2. Create a world using the Biomes O Plenty world generator type.
3. The game will freeze on "Loading world". Checking your game log will state the server state changed to stopped and a crash report is added to your crash reports folder, though the client never realizes the game crashed
4. Use command prompt or task manager to force kill Minecraft.

#### Additional Information:

[Crash report](https://pastebin.com/z1R42sAj)
____
#### Affected Versions:

- Biomes O' Plenty: 1.11.2-6.1.0.2238-universal
- Minecraft: 1.11.2
- Forge: 13.20.0.2313

I'm running a server and my client which has the same mods as me, has different biome names sometimes. E.g. they have Ominous Woods but it's supposed to be Woodlands. issues.title: Biomes should use Forge registry
issues.body: Peeking at the source code, it looks like the biomes use the vanilla Biome registry (`Biome.registerBiome`) but not the Forge registry (`GameRegistry.register`). They should use (only) the Forge registry in order to facilitate compatibility with other mods (i.e. preventing biome ID conflicts), and so that the biome IDs do not have to be configured (since by registering using Forge, it handles IDs in a similar way to block IDs).

issues.title: Palm tress "losing" leaves.
issues.body:
**Tested on:**

Minecraft 1.11.2
Forge 1.11.2 - 13.20.0.2264 and Forge 1.11.2 - 13.20.0.2228 
BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.0.2.2168 and BiomesOPlenty-1.11.2-6.0.2.2169

_No other mods installed_

**The Issue:**

In either an Oasis (95) or Tropical Island (100), after chopping down a few of the naturally spawned Palm Trees (and those 2 block tall Jungle Trees) - all the Palm Trees around start losing all their leaves and end up as near leaf-less trunks.

**To recreate:**

Make a (all default settings) BOP world with seed: 3717748747580043595

Spawns you on a Tropical Island (100) Biome, pick a spot and start harvesting some Palm Trees and Jungle Trees (have to make a boat, after all). In my world (survival & creative) all the Palm Trees slowly start losing most or all of their leaves and end up being mostly bare trunks.

_It takes some time_ but it always seems to happen, I've also tried it in an Oasis Biome and had the same result.

Thanks - Daniel.

P.S. I love this mod <3.

issues.title: Request: 1.10.2 BoP Configuration files for integration with Terrain Control
issues.body:
In reference to #936 
Since 1.8 BoP it seems configuration is essentially done via Generator Options settings instead of as in 1.7.10 with configuration files.
I'm looking for a way to integrate the great source of terrain blocks, ores, trees, plants, ... BoP is, into biomes generated with Terrain Control (the mods on which BiomeBundles is actually built).
Currently when choosing WorldType: TerrainControl (instead of BiomesOP) I cannot disable the terraingenerating features of BoP.
I'm kindly requesting an option to disable the terrain generating features in the overworld via a configuration file (for 1.10.2), as that is currently the dimension that terraincontrols handles.

If this is not possible. I kindly request permission for the community to be allow to use the assets of BoP (textures) so that we can recreate those resources with a custom resource pack mod, and be able to enhance our worlds with TerrainControl.

Sinceerly,
Guinaro

issues.title: BOP plantables should be using canSustainPlant()
issues.body:
BOP plantables are not using canSustainPlant() to test if the block they're being put on is valid. This is limiting cross compatibility with other mods. 

As an Example:
https://github.com/grim3212/grim-pack/issues/82 Grim-Pack has a planting pot that can be set to various soil types (dirt, grass, farmland, soul sand, sand, etc). BOP plantables (Trees, flowers) cannot be planted on it even when set to the correct soil setting.

#### Issue Description:
Pistons are duplicating them selves.

issues.title: [1.10.2] Server thread crash placing EnderIO Farming Station at Y=62 in a BoP Marsh
issues.body:
Posted to EnderIO at first. They requested I cross-post here.
https://github.com/SleepyTrousers/EnderIO/issues/3796

Issue Description:

OK, really weird one. A player on my server reported her newly-crafted farming station behaving strangely. During my investigation I was able to establish:
- The problem was not unique to her particular farming station. The problem also happened with a spawned one, and one I had been using at my base for a while.
- If placed at Y=62, we get a thread crash on the server. If placed one block higher or lower, no problem.
- In the capacitor, we see power being drawn. In the farm, the energy buffer remains empty.
- Sometimes saplings are used but not placed.
- I couldn't replicate this problem at my base, so I flew around trying different biomes. Appears to be unique to the BoP Marsh biome and not dependent on chunk borders. I was only able to find two Marshes (opposite sides of the map). Tried in several vanilla and BoP biomes and the problem only appeared in the two marshes.
- A Vat did not exhibit the problem.
- Only happens when the farm tries to use power, but can be from a conduit or capacitor. For example, if the farm had some stored energy (from a negative test in a non-Marsh biome), simply placing the farm would result in the thread crash. Placing a capacitor next to it, would cause a second thread crash.

What you expected to happen:

```
Normal farm operation.
```

Steps to reproduce:
- Find a BoP "Marsh"
- Place a power source
- Place a farming station
- Observe thread crash on server console

issues.title: Fire Decorate Events rather than cancel them
issues.body:
# The Problem

Since the latest few versions, my mod Recurrent Complex has a decoration (e.g. trees) replacement engine. For it to work, the decorations are expected to scattered determined by the vanilla biome decorator (e.g. treesPerBiome). Since BoP doesn't use the vanilla engine, and instead sets all the default decoration values to 0, the tree replacements don't trigger and BoP's trees are being spawned as usual.

I'd like to be able to provide compatibility with your system.
# Solution Proposal

I've designed a [Forge PR (3318)](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/pull/3318) to enable all mods this compatibility. In short, the Decorate event starts providing 3 methods: boolean hasAmountData(), int getModifiedAmount and setModifiedAmount(int).

However, LexManos doesn't seem to want to merge it anytime soon, so in https://github.com/Ivorforce/RecurrentComplex/issues/96 I've decided on implementing it anyway, which whichonespink44 did for RTG in https://github.com/Team-RTG/Realistic-Terrain-Generation/pull/1011.

I've looked up how BoP currently handles decoration, and it seems to cancel the vanilla decoration event and insert their own.
That would be an acceptable solution (though incompatible with my proposal) if the event promised to fire just once per biome. [However, that is already not the case](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/blob/1.10.x/patches/minecraft/net/minecraft/world/biome/BiomeForest.java.patch#L31-L37). Amount data or not, imo this approach is not viable even with the current state of the event.
# Implementation Proposal

I'd suggest hooking into BiomeDecorationEvent.Pre and run over _your_ decoration types manually (while either canceling the vanilla events, or even better just pronouncing them useless by setting treesPerBiome etc. to -999 (which you already do).

Then you'd be able to fire subclasses of the decoration events yourself that include the amount (hasAmountData , getAmoundData, setAmountData) of decoration objects being spawned, which ReC and other mods can use and/or cancel for mod interaction. You'd also be able to add more context data to the subclasses (a proposal by Lex himself).

Feel free to add suggestions of how to better approach the problem, as I'm not super familiar with how BoP likes to handle things.

issues.title: Scythe breaks original position before expected, causing crash.
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

Because of a quirk in how the scythes work, they can cause crashes in other mod's blocks.
#### Steps to reproduce:
1. Get Botania 314
2. Get BOP 2052
3. Place a botania pure daisy and break it with a scythe directly (not indirectly)
#### Technical Description:

When, I break a block with BOP scythe in hand these things happen, in order.
1. Play particles and sound
2. Call `Item.onBlockDestroyed`
3. Call `Block.removedByPlayer`, which spawns drops via onBlockHarvested, getDrops, that whole process and sets the pos to air in-world
4. Call `Block.onBlockDestroyedByPlayer` (irrelevant to issue, here for completeness)

I have custom logic in `removedByPlayer`/`getDrops` that drops items based on the Tile Entity of my block (Botania magic flowers).
_The problem is_, the scythe has already run trimming logic in the original blockpos, overwriting my block with air and removing the TE before the block expects it to be gone. `removedByPlayer` essentially expects the block to still be in place in the world. It tries to get the TE and crashes. This crash will occur for any block that the scythe trims, that also has harvest logic based on the TE.

1.9 vs 1.10 shouldn't matter for this bug.

---
#### Affected Versions (Exact numbers, do _not_ use "latest"):
- Biomes O' Plenty: 2052
- Minecraft: 1.10.2
- Forge: 2041

issues.title: Config system currently is not useful.
issues.body:
So currently there is 4 config options people can see and edit made by default.
FOUR.  
This new config system is an awful idea in its current state. 
Here is why:
1. Zero examples of complete files. How do you expect people to know the JSON format they need for editing each biome or even other general configs?  
2. Wiki information is broad and mostly useless to anyone trying to use this system. Examples, examples, examples. If you ever want people to pick up on your almighty config system you need to show them how to use it else they will just use a another mod that is user friendly.  
3. Simple options that existed before are now moved into a complicated burden of configs. People who like BoP and want to disable X biome or remove poison ivy will not use the mod. They don't want to spend 4 hours trying to figure out some convoluted config system just to remove or enable a feature.  
4. People regardless of experience or know how will opt for other mods. I have delt with this first hand on a small user base with no other mod available. Pay2Spawn uses a JSON file to store all the data it needs to work but even with an ingame GUI editor and an extensive wiki that took days to write people just said "It's not worth my time for what I want to do."

I understand you want people to have the power to edit things and not overwrite them or they never get the changes but there are other ways to go about it that involve less stress on both sides.  

Examples:
1. Give all the config options to the user put general options in one location and the rest broken down however they need be. When you push an update that needs to edit the files backup the folder and write a new one. Lycanite's mobs uses this system. It can be annoying but lets people who what to edit whatever do it without knowing how to make the files.  
2. Make one set of files that always match the default settings of BoP and have the user copy the file into a folder that overrides the defaults. Simple for the users of any skill level and it will include all the required files for the person to edit without guessing anything, AE2 Uses this system for its crafting recipes.

I speak from experience on this I'm not here to just yell empty words at you. I make my own packs, I run servers, I work with tons of people of varying levels of skill and I will avoid BoP even though it was my go to biome mod in 1.7.10 purely because I don't want to spend the time to learn a system that is proven to be nothing but a larger workload on the devs and the users. Please reconsider this system while thinking about what you are doing to the BoP users and yourself.

issues.title: [1.10] biomeweights.cfg no longer used?
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

File biomeweights.cfg is no longer generated and if I try to create one and specify one of the biome weight to increase, it has no effect. I used same spelling for biomes as in biome_ids.json, for instance for "Redwood Forest" it is spelled "I:redwood_forest". This seems to be a change since 1.7.10. Even 1.8.9 does not have this file anymore. Is this replaced by BoP config options in-game? If so, I do not see biome weight there.
#### Steps to reproduce:
1. Create BoP world
2. check biomes nearby
3. no effect on biome weight.

- Biomes O' Plenty: BiomesOPlenty-1.9.4-4.1.0.2033-universal

issues.title: [1.9.4] Use of method that doesn't exists, it was renamed. getBiomeGenForCoords -> getBiome
issues.body:
Here https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/BOP-1.9.4-4.1.x/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/handler/decoration/DecorateBiomeEventHandler.java#L81

Edit: looks like the method is in there because it still exists in the mappings being used by the project. Newer mappings doesn't have it.

issues.title: MAJOR BUG (1.9 and 1.9.4) : Catched unhandled exception java.lang.NullPointerException
issues.body:
## IMPORTANT : THIS BUG IS GENERAL TO MANY MODS OF MINECRAFT 1.9 and 1.9.4

A strange bug happens when a tile entity is destroyed, Almost all the time an exception is thrown when the bug happens : Catched unhandled exception  [name of the tile entity] java.lang.NullPointerException 
For some particular blocks, Minecraft totally freezes and finished to crash with the error code -805306369 without any crash report. Here is the list of all the blocks wich are confirmed to provocate Minecraft to freeze and crashs with this error.
- Building Brick : all the glass, ice and packed ice blocks
- Deep Resonance : resonant crystal
- Biomes O Plenty : celestial crystal
- Botania : mana prism
- Blood Arsenal : blood stained glass block and pane
- Evilcraft : darktank
- EnderIO : killer joe, zombie generator, all the fused quartz glasses
- Random Things : lapis lamp, quartz lamp, rainbow lamp, biome glass, spectre block, fluid display

All these blocks follow the same error, only the name of the tile entity between the [ ] changes. Here is an example of how the error happens. The example is made with the resonant crystal of deep resonance. This is a full log and contains the launching of minecraft and the loading of a world, the moment where I brick the block and the bug happens is the moment where the exception [class com.hea3ven.buildingbricks.core.tileentity.TileMaterial] java.lang.NullPointerException is thrown : http://pastebin.com/KhwV1WKg

---

Moreover some tile entities wich has brokner provocates Minecraft to totally crash with a crash report. Here is the list of all the block concerned and their crash report
- EvilCraft : box of eternal closure http://pastebin.com/JzRYf5Ex
- Cooking for block heads : fridge and oven http://pastebin.com/vcmx49qn http://pastebin.com/6zd4qq5w
- Storage Drawers : framing table http://pastebin.com/3077W3Wz

---

I let you know that all the tests possible has already been made before I create this general issue and post it. I already tried to :
- Test the mod one by one only by installing them and forge without any other mods
- Change of Forge Version
- Change between the 1.9 and 1.9.4 version
- Change of mod version
- Play without optifine and any shaders
- Switch between the creative and survival mode
  Nothing of all that change anything, the bug still happens in the same way for the same blocks listed at the top. 

---

I precise that almost all the mods in Minecraft 1.9.4 and 1.9 are touched by this bug, because even if they don't provocate Minecraft to freeze or crash, almost always at each time a tile entity is broken, the exception Catched unhandled exception  [name of the tile entity] java.lang.NullPointerException is thrown.
I precise too that the list of all the tile entities listed at the top can be incomplete. I want you know that I tried to break block by block all the blocks of almost all the most popular mods on 1.9.4 and 1.9, so for summarizing something like 50 mods with more than 2000 blocks. So it's possible that I missed some blocks.
It's why I send this issue to all the mods even if no ones of their block are concerned by the bug.
I invite all the mod developpers to try by themselves to break all the tile entities of their mod for seeing they provocate the throwing of the exception, and maybe causes Minecraft to freeze.

issues.body:
http://pastebin.com/JbbZNYNc

Originally posted on minecraftforums but posted here at a commenter's suggestion. Seems like BOP was crashing my game, but it's currently unknown as to why. Crashes were infrequent, occurring roughly 2 to 3 times an hour, usually when I entered new areas that had a lot of terrain generation such as trees/plants. Once removed, crashes stopped altogether, but I would still like to know why the crashes were happening to begin with. I am playing 1.7.10. BOP version 2.1.0.1521. Forge version 10.13.4.1558. 
I am aware that the BOP version for 1.7.10 is not the latest version, but it's the most recent one I could find that would play with my forge version. Reason I am not playing with the latest forge version for 1.7.10 is because I play with some older mods and they don't work with newer forge versions. I did test BOP alone without any of the other mods and there were no crashes to report within a 1 hour time period.

issues.body:
Feature Request.

Compatibility with the Thaumcraft (1.8.9) Destroyer enchant:
Make BoP sand and dirt-type blocks react the same way as vanilla sand/dirt with the Shovel of the Earthmover / Destroyer enchantment. This makes it possible to mine a 3x3 area of blocks instead of 1 at a time.

Right now, ashes and other sand/dirt-type blocks like loamy dirt can't be mined with the 3x3 enchant for some reason, the area mined stays a single block.

issues.title: BlockBOPLeaves drops ItemStack with null ITem
issues.body:
#### Issue Description:

In BOP for Minecraft 1.8.9, [BlockBOPLeaves#getItemDropped](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/BOP-1.8.9-3.0.x/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/block/BlockBOPLeaves.java#L230) can return a null `Item`. Since `BlockLeaves` does not perform a null check when calling this method, an `ItemStack` with a null `Item` gets created.

When an `EntityItem` is spawned in with the bad `ItemStack`, other mods break when expecting a non-null `Item`.
#### Steps to reproduce:
1. Place several 'Giant Red Flower Petal' block
2. Break the block repeatedly with an axe, until an item drops.
3. Observe that the spawned `EntityItem` has an `ItemStack` with a null `Item`.

issues.title: Strata Generation
issues.body:
This probably won't be for the initial 1.8.9 release, but basically there'll be four layers:
- Stone
- Limestone
- Siltstone
- Shale

Each requiring a certain level of pickaxe to mine. Ores will be surrounded by a cluster of regular stone so they don't look horrible. Random regular stone clusters will also be generated so as to not immediately give away the locations of ores.

In terms of config options, we'll likely have
- Generate strata on/off
- Tiered strata mining (on/off)

issues.title: [1.7.10] Wetland COLD/WARM change
issues.body:
After 1.7.10-2.1.0.1067, the Wetland biome was changed from COLD to WARM.This means that with the exact same config and seed, BoP now generates entirely different terrain. Because of this, I can't update my server past that version.

I have confirmed that changing that back in the latest 1.7.10 code causes BoP to generate the same terrain as before with no other changes. Note, however, I do have most BoP biomes disabled.

If you want, I've got a pull request that changes this back. I figure if this change is acceptable, it's easier than me maintaining a custom fork.

issues.title: [1.7.10] Disabled (null) biomes still registered to Biome Dictionary
issues.body:
As per the title, BOP still tries to register disabled (ID=-1) biomes to the Biome Dictionary, triggering an NPE during load.

The easiest fix is to edit `addBiomesToDictionary` and replace all the calls to `BiomeDictionary.registerBiomeType` with a method delegate that checks `biome != null` then passes it on.

EDIT:
I will PR the fix.

EDIT 2: There are multiple other similar issues, including in `disableRiver` and `BOPEntities.registerEntities`. The PR has not been updated because I am going to bed. :P

issues.title: Smelting logs to charcoal gives way too much XP
issues.body:
In `BOPCrafting.java` logs smelting to charcoal gives has an XP value of `15.0F`. My understanding is this gives a 1500% chance to give 1 XP per log smelted. If not capped to 100%, this gives an extremely large (37+ levels) per stack smelted. You probably meant `0.15F`, which is the vanilla value.

See also SleepyTrousers/EnderIO#1530

I set up an auto farm in a Fen biome of dark oak trees using thermal expansion/minefactory reloaded.  I placed a layer of dirt on which to grow the trees, with a planter underneath.  Also underneath the dirt, I placed itemducts to feed the saplings from the harvester back into the planter.  Sometimes when the trees grow, they replace the dirt on which they are planted with dark oak wood, destroying the dirt.  Sometimes this replacement goes two levels deep, even replacing and destroying the itemducts feeding the saplings back to the planter, breaking the loop and shutting down the system.

Modules in use are:

appliedenergistics2-rv2-stable-10.jar
BiomesOPlenty-1.7.10-2.1.0.1394-universal.jar

issues.title: update older world with biomes o' plenty from 1.6.2 to 1.7.10
issues.body:
So I'd like to update my world from 1.6.2 to 1.7.10 but the ID's seem to have changed between the versions of biome's o plenty and like 62 blocks types are missing. Now I am not experienced in the world of software development and programming but I am trying to learn by looking for similar problems in the web.

Now one solution I have read about is that for most mods there is a preparation update that can will prepare your world for the new version but I haven't seen anything mention about that for biomes o'plenty. So do I just update to the latest version of 1.6.2 biomes o'plenty and then to 1.6.3 and 1.6.4 and then to 1.7.10 ? so that the world is prepared each time for the changes? seems a bit of a wrong logic.

Another solution I think could work is changing the Ids.cfg, but it seems the block IDs are no more included in this file for the 1.7.10 version? and will I not likely have conflicts when I mess around with the IDs?

It has to be possible to update a older world to 1.7.10 , no?

issues.body:
BiomesOPlenty-1.7.10-2.1.0.1364-universal.jar

1) Create new world 2) find Cherry Blossom Grove biome 3) fly around in creative and notice the FPS spikes down to 0 every so often.

If you don't move around the FPS seems to be stable. The Shift + F3 menu is showing the cause of the spikes to be "root.tick.level.chunkCache.recheckGaps.checkedPosition < toCheckCount". I also noticed that a lot of the leaves on the pink/white cherry trees will despawn because they are too far from a log. I also noted that if you afk for about 10 minutes after discovering the biome the lag will go away. This leads me to believe it has something to do with leaf or item decay.

I am playing with a custom private modpack but have verified the lag also exists with only BoP installed.

issues.title: Mod-Added Wood Blocks Should Count For "Getting Wood" Achievement
issues.body:
## Software Configuration used for testing
- Forge 10.13.4.1448-1.7.10
- BiomesOPlenty-1.7.10-2.1.0.1364-universal.jar (MD5: 7aa072f0f943d67d5dbf7ad1a259b673)

I've also confirmed this to still be present in the current latest public builds of Forge and BoP for 1.8, though I only have detailed steps for 1.7.10:
- Forge 11.14.3.1487-1.8
- BiomesOPlenty-1.8-3.0.0.1365-universal.jar (MD5: e74ad3aa360540affbc3dd2ed352e234)
## Repro steps
1. Optional: in forge.cfg, set B:spawnHasFuzz=false and I:defaultSpawnFuzz=0 to see exactly what I saw right away.
2. Start Minecraft.
3. Create a new world, with World Type: Biomes O' Plenty, Seed: -8030104888094733544.  Leave other options at their defaults.
4. Whenever you spawn into the world, open your inventory to get the "Taking Inventory" achievement.
5. Head to x=34, y=67, z=1003, which is a location right next to a tree.
6. Harvest one or more blocks of Pine Wood from this tree:
   ![Step 6 Screenshot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/3792815/8481797/570565c4-20b3-11e5-80da-53bc6a02eab9.png)
7. Now head to x=27, y=68, z=975, which is a location right next to another tree.
8. Harvest one or more blocks of Spruce Wood from this tree.
   ![Step 8 Screenshot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/3792815/8481796/57022936-20b3-11e5-815f-cb52da099531.png)

Expected: the "Getting Wood" achievement should have been completed on step 6.
Actual: the "Getting Wood" achievement is only completed at step 8.
## Impact

On some mod packs, players can find themselves starting off in very hazardous locations, and achievements are not immediately on their minds as much as survival.  The vanilla Minecraft achievement system is set up so that the natural first-steps into the world reward some "starter" achievements; if the player happens to spawn into a biome that has BoP-added trees and miss "Getting Wood", they will find themselves behind the curve, having to play "catch-up" sometime later once they find some vanilla wood blocks if they want to get nearly any vanilla achievements at all.

It's obviously not the end of the world the way it is right now, but I couldn't find something like this in the GitHub issue tracker or the code no matter how hard I searched (I didn't look through every commit since 1.7.10, though I did at least do a surface-level confirmation that it's still a thing in 1.8, as mentioned above).  I'm not familiar with what you get from the Forge API as far as possible ways of fixing this, so I'm not 100% sure this is something you guys can reasonably fix.  If nothing else, I'd at least like to be able to point to either an "open" or a "wontfix" issue on GitHub if someone asks about this.

issues.title: [1.7.10] [2.1.0.1338] Flowering Oak saplings never grow; Apple Tree saplings have persimmons.
issues.body: Flowering oak saplings never grow, either naturally (~20 hours gameplay with several flowering oak saplings in loaded chunks, none grew) or with bonemeal / 3rd-party "fertilizers" like the OpenBlocks watering can.  Apple tree saplings produce apple trees with persimmons in place of apples.  Tested with and without other mods.

issues.title: Amethyst armor makes you invincible
issues.body:
Apparently the points for amethyst armor are too high, and it makes you invincible.

According to @Fickilty:

> Quite literally invincible. It might be a forge bug. My partner and I found a forge bug (fixed in the latest 1.8 version) where armour doesn't behave the way it should.
> What the bug did: Damage resistance was based on armour durability not armour points.
> Amethyst armour making the player invincible isn't really an issue at the moment though, as there's no current way to get ender amethysts without adding recipes for them/creative/commands.
> When changing amethyst armour points, you might want to keep in mind other mods adding in armour as well. Because I know that with: amethyst helmet, diamond chestplate, diamond leggings, and metallurgy tartarite boots that "sweet" invincible spot of 25 armour points is reached.
> Likewise with: amethyst helmet, IC2 composite vest, diamond leggings, diamond boots the player is rendered invincible.
> For reference, amethyst helmets and boots, offer the /least/ amount of protection from the set, with other mods that invincible point is still reached.
> I feel like I butchered my grammar a few times there. Sorry about that. It's nearly 3am.

issues.title: [1.7.10][Suggestion] Change potion ID registering so it doesn't mess up if BoP is loaded after other mods that extend potion array
issues.body:
EDIT: Previously the title was about the Possession potion ID being set to 256, which caused the nether phantom to crash the client when it hit you. The third post has more info, but BoP's method is messing up after another mod loads before BoP that extends the potion array (In this case, it was AbyssalCraft). The fix, for now, is to rename the BoP jar to "aBiomesOPlenty" so it's at the top of the list.

Title, really. This crash only occurs when a phantom in the Nether hits you. After the crash, if I look at the player.dat file (or level.dat in single player), I see an active effect with ID 0. I used NEI to dump the potion IDs list and noticed that paralysis is set to 255, and possession is set to 256. Since the max is 255, I'm guessing either 256 is null or rounds over to 0. Either way, this is a pretty big issue, and there are several threads out there that talk about this. This is a copy of #388, just with more detail. Same crash reports.

Should be noted that with just BoP installed, the two potions register to 31 and 32 (I think, somewhere around that). So it could be a mod interaction, maybe. micdoodle8/Galacticraft#1365 suggests Blood Magic, but the removal of this didn't change anything, not to mention modpacks like FTB Infinity and DW20 do not have this issue (and have BM). The potions aren't even listed in the ID dump for those packs, I'm unsure how they did that. They use BoP version 1067. I've tried this one, with no luck. I've also tried a few of the latest, up to 1127.

Other references on this issue:
- WayofTime/BloodMagic#241, third comment.
- micdoodle8/Galacticraft#1323
- micdoodle8/Galacticraft#1366

In case anyone's wondering, removing Galacticraft does not solve it, these were reported to GC's github simply because the reports use GC's player class thing instead of the normal vanilla one.

I think BoP used to have a configuration option to set potion IDs, though I know it used to have one to disable phantom spawning. This really needs to come back, so that this issue could be avoided in the future. For now, I'll be going through and removing mods until this stops happening, to determine a more exact mod interaction cause. I just wanted to bring this to your attention and hopefully get some insight on this. If you need any more information, let me know.

issues.title: License prohibits pull requests
issues.body:
Hi all,

I just read the the [license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/deed.en_US) and was puzzled by the ND clause:

> **NoDerivatives** — If you remix, transform, or build upon the material, you may not distribute the modified material.

However if you do a pull request you have to fork this repository, _modify_ some of the material, and lastly send a request this to merged in to the the master (or other) branch. But since all forks are/need to be public for this to work that means they violate the license.

I don't know if this is strictly true, but I do feel very uneasy for the prospect of contributing to this project. I'm sure that is not was intended, but it might be good to survey alternatives and check what exactly this license implies. The easiest fix is to drop ND from the license, but that requires all copyright holders to agree to this change, which leads to the question of CLA.

But for that you can use [CLAhub](https://www.clahub.com/) to make it easy to enforce.

issues.title: Mud pick is using Amethyst Harvestlevel
issues.body:
The BOPPickaxe implementation sets the HarvestLevel to 4: https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/BOP-1.7.10-2.1.x/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/common/items/ItemBOPPickaxe.java#L19

This means that the toolMaterials harvestlevel is ignored when querying the harvestlevel. The mud pick therefore has harvest level 4 instead of 0.
Simply set it to toolMaterial.getHarvestLevel() instead of 4.

issues.title: Twilight Forest biomes generating in BOP overworld
issues.body:
The title pretty much says it all - when using the Twilight Forest mod together with BiomesOPlenty I occasionally get TF biomes generating in the overworld (with BOP worldtype chosen).
I am quite puzzled as nobody else seems to have reported that issue, so at first I thought that I personally might have done something wrong. Having had a friend check on this and verify the bug I am now comfortable to report it to you.

I have tried several biome IDs, two times I remapped the complete TF ID range, then again I tested it with standard IDs. None of those IDs seemed to overlap or conflict and I am positive that there is no ID conflict that I could be aware of.
There was an issue though where TF auto-mapped its IDs so that some of them conflicted BOP biome IDs, but this only seemed to happen when other mods were present that brought biomes into the game and it didn't happen anymore with only TF and BOP installed.
As of now I have seen three TF biomes generating in the overworld, the "Enchanted Forest", "Thornlands" and "Dark Forest" biomes, but only occasionally. 

Technical details/mod versions:
I have had this issue with several versions of Forge and several versions of BOP (at least .985, .986 and .987, but I believe I also had this issue with a version from before the fix that broke "seed-compatibility") and tested it with Java 7 versions 1.7.0_55 and 1.7.0_67 and Java 8 version 1.8.0-b132 (all 64-Bit). I have been able to consistently reproduce this with the following versions, using default configs:

Java 1.7.0_67 64-Bit, MultiMC 5 0.4.2, Minecraft 1.7.10, Forge 10.13.0.1207, Twilight Forest 2.2.3, BiomesOPlenty 2.1.0.987.
Starting a world with BOP world type and the following seed

-2845210373478548811

there is a TF Enchanted Forest biome at coordinates X = -1900, Y, Z = 2450.

I am not sure if this issue is caused by Biomes O Plenty or not, I guess I will post a link to this report at the Twilight Forest forum thread or Github page too. Please still check up on this though! =D

issues.title: [1.7.10] Make biomes comfortable for specific forestry hives again
issues.body:
I think something is changed around BoP biome temperature and humidity (at least in handling) because forestry cannot spawn specific beehives anymore. For example, in 1.6 sacred springs was a jungle-like biome (WARM and DAMP) and forestry could spawn a Jungle hive here. I went through 4-5 sacred springs biome, but no jungle hive spawned, even if i checked sacred oaks too.  As because jungle hives can spawn only on a bit taller trees (so they cannot ambush in bushes, like meadows or unusual hives) I am pretty sure I didn't miss one or more, because sacred springs spawn only sacred oaks and some harvestcraft trees. 

Also, most of biomes what spawn spruce/pine tree naturally should be a COLD biome, so Icy hives can spawn here.

This is important because the vanilla jungle and snowy biomes are extreme rare (in vanilla worldgen too), and some bee crossbreeding cannot reacheed without them.

issues.title: Additional OreDictionary support for food
issues.body:
Barley - should be registered as cropBarley.
Sunflower Seeds - should be registered as cropSunflower. (Not a derp, it's really "crop")
Persimmon - should be registered as cropPersimmon.
Turnip - should be registered as cropTurnip.
Turnip Seeds - should be registered as seedTurnip.
This stuff will allow players to use BiomesOPlenty food in HarvestCraft recipes.

issues.title: Fluid duplication glitch
issues.body:
You can still use a bucket to place a fluid as long as the fluid amount is above 0, even if it is under 1000mB.

Also, I'm not sure of why you implemented your bucket using ItemFluidContainer instead of just making a new instance of ItemBucket (and passing your FluidBlock) and using the FluidContainerRegistry because your implementation causes a lot of problems:
- Using the bucket in anything that manages IFluidContainers correctly will result in a BiomesOPlenty:bopBucket instead of a vanilla bucket.
- That bucket cannot pick up any liquid from the ground
- That bucket will accept any fluid using something that manages IFluidContainers (like fluid transposers), but the texture will still be the empty bucket texture and the name will be... weird ?
- There doesn't seem to be a bucket container for the BOP fluids in the FluidContainerRegistry
- the bug reported here (well that can be fixed but it's weird)
- [fixed] They won't work on most tanks as the tanks look through the fluidcontainer registry to know what fluid your bucket is holding.
- (OCD level) Isn't it less efficient to store the fluid type /per/ bucket as NBT instead of storing it per bucket type by making a new ItemBucket instance ? ~

TL;DR: It's not usefull to reimplement the vanilla bucket when all it does is nothing more than being a bucket. You should keep that for new fluid containers (and add support for every fluid while you're at it [or whitelist your fluids]).

Obviously that's just my opinion, feel free to tell me to mind my own business.

issues.title: Highlands Mod Compatibility; BoP Ignoring configs.
issues.body:
This is a quote from the current curator of Highlands mod regarding the setting "Use Biomes O' Plenty biomes in Highlands worlds." For some reason when you use this option, if you have disabled biomes in the BoP config, they generate anyway.

Quote from fabricator77

I tried to figure out how BoP disables biomes when I wrote my code, but couldn't. Seems they directly read config settings one at a time for each biome, after they register the biome with Forge/BoP API. In other words the only way to access it is to either hack into their code, or read their config file directly using the same sort of method. Nether way should be necessary.

When you disable a biome in Highlands (or my other biome mod), it doesn't register it at all.
The only fix I can do to disable BoP biomes is to get the biome weighting code in Highlands working.

Any Idea how to fix this? :octopus:

issues.title: Various saplings misbehaving
issues.body:
Hello,

With forge-1.7.10-10.13.0.1197 and biomesoplenty-1.7.10-2.1.0.961, I observed the following quirks:

Redwood saplings will not grow in a 3x3 or 1x1 in any biome, including redwood forest.  The sapling will occasionally change to a sacred oak sapling on a tick and then back to a redwood sapling.

Willow saplings will grow, but the bottom block is replaced by a mangrove sapling when the tree grows, which then "pops off" the dirt, leaving an empty block

Mangrove saplings will plant, but "pop off" the sand when growth is triggered.  Can provide screens if needed.

Thanks for the great mod!

Edit - I was unable to get the willow sapling issue to repeat, so unsure what caused it.
I did notice, however, that the palm sapling will not grow on dirt or podzol (this may be intentional), and when planted on grass, the trunk will "grow" from a block directly adjacent to the sapling (also may be intentional)

issues.title: Flowing poison liquid does not update correctly.
issues.body:
Whenever I encounter flowing poison pools while mining underground for ores, I remove them with a bucket by placing one source block into another, removing them one at a time as I go through the pool, as this is the least resource intensive method to remove them with.  I use this method as often there are ores in the pool that I need to dig out, and it's not fun swimming in liquid poison.  it's also not fun having to dig away filler material to expose the ores again.

Unfortunately, the liquid poison pools don't update the liquid flow correctly, and I have to log out of the world I'm in and back in again to remove the flowing liquid poison sources, as they are visually glitched client-side.

issues.title: Exception preparing structure feature
issues.body:
I simply shutdown my server, and tried to start it. Simply stopped working :( 
I changed nothing at all; 
For informational purposes i'm using attack of b team with some more mods;
Using MCPC+ in 262
Minecraft 1.6.4, latest BOP for this version

It seems that it is trying to generate a stronghold in chunk -8 -8, there is any way to tell it to stop generating this structure?

issues.title: Shared biome number for biome ids
issues.body:
Going to a new area, after updating BoP, gave Corrupted Sands in the middle of the ocean. So I took a look at the ID's to see if something had been changed somehow. I found these two biomes sharing the same ID number:
 I:"Corrupted Sands ID"=105
 I:"Kelp Forest ID"=105

Looking through the other numbers it turns out that Tropics and Coral Reef also share the same number, 104.

Also, I had a request, please please don't change the id number on biomes, if it is avoidable. It can be such a mess to figure out when updating the mod, and still playing the same map. (I don't know if you guys are already trying to avoid it)

I mentioned this in the IRC channel, it's causing issues with compatibility with other mods.  Not causing crashes, just mods that check for instanceof BlockTallGrass like mine.

Could the BOP grass extend BlockTallGrass for better compatibility with other mods please?  Adubbz was fairly open to the idea when I mentioned it.

issues.title: Rosters can be exploited for mass production of red dye
issues.body:
Since roseters immediately replace the roses that are broken where they stand, using a block breaker such as the Applied Energistics Transition Plane can be used to harvest these roses at a rate of up to 4 per tick per roseter.

These roses, once turned into dye can be processed into fuel using the MFR BioReactor, and be used to power a HUGE number of Railcraft boilers, or other power production system that uses liquid fuel.

Within 20 minutes I was able to get over 45k roses with 4 roseters.

http://puu.sh/5CG1w.jpg
http://puu.sh/5CFi0.jpg

issues.title: BoP Nether and Natura Nether generation
issues.body:
Using BoP and Natura together, there's a small issue.

Natura adds a lot of Nether stuff, however, it also adds Heat Sand and Tainted Soil to landscape generation.

Thankfully you can turn it off in Natura's config via B:"Override Nether"=false , but... BoP seems to ignore it willingly and still generate Heat Sand and Tainted Soil.

In TinkerConstruct's IRC mdiyo told me it might be on BoP side. So, just putting it out there.

issues.title: Last few updates have issues with TreeCapitator.
issues.body:
With the last few updates it seems TreeCapitator can't work with BoP anymore with a lot of these trees.

I know TreeCap has a config file where I can add all the id's necessary, but they seem not to work mostly. It worked before. I also know you did an ID restructure, so I've checked and rechecked if these new IDs are the correct ones, they are.

The only trees I found to be able to work with TreeCap is the apple tree, dead tree and acacia tree.

Edit: After extensive testing only apple tree, dead tree and accacia tree (without leaves breaking) work. Every single other BoP tree doesn't work with TreeCapacitor anymore.

issues.title: Biome Size 2 = Infinite Oceans
issues.body:
Setting the Biome Size in the configuration files to 2 actually does work now, resulting in a small land mass with smaller than normal sized biomes. (This used to be an ignored setting in previous versions.) Unfortunately it seems to be having a direct opposite affect on all of the ocean biomes now. I generated three different maps from three random seeds, each one generated using Biomes O'Plenty (all under MC1.6.2) with Biome Size set to 2. Every single time I would spawn on a small to tiny land mass (sometimes just a tiny island) that would be surrounded by ocean in all directions for a minimum of 100,000 blocks distance from spawn. (I stopped at 100,000 blocks because I got bored after checking that in 8 separate compass point directions several times over.)

On the third map I stopped at +120000, 65, -120000 and saved the map then exited the client. I went into configs, adjusted the biome size back up to 3 (from 2) then reloaded the client and the map at the same position. Once I did this I was able to go a mere 12 chunks north and immediately found a massive land mass stretching off from that point.

This has been fairly consistently testable for me, so it should be reproducible for anyone else.

issues.title: Gems not spawning properly when mods that replace stone are used
issues.body: With Underground Biomes a lot of the stone is replaced with other kinds of stone.  This looks like it stops gems from generating in many biomes.  According to the Underground Biomes author, the fix is to change the worldgen code from looking for Block.stone.blockID and instead use Block.isGenMineableReplaceable()

issues.title: [BUG][V0.6.2:MC1.6.2] Liquid Poison Bucket don't come back when placed in tank suporting Fluid System
issues.body:
When placing a bucket a Liqud Poison in tank from Buildcraft or Tinker Construct you don't get the bucket back. Due to the fact than a Bucket CAN handle lava, I supose this is not a feature since I have preference for Poison bath over Lava bath.

BTW: Sometime swimming don't let you go up because I drowning. Like in a 3 block deep pool ;). Append in Poison and Spring Water

issues.title: Willow tree growth is blocked by "willow" blocks
issues.body:
See https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/master/src/minecraft/biomesoplenty/worldgen/WorldGenWillow.java#L54 - the willow tree generator will overwrite air and Blocks.leavesColorized, but not Blocks.willow (the vine-like blocks that hang from willow trees) so overlapping willow trees can't be grown.

Also, it looks like the height limit is hard-coded as 128, but I'm not familiar with world-gen code so that may be intentional.

issues.title: Hot Springs OP with naturalRegen off
issues.body: With naturalRegen off, Hot Springs still Regenerate health, they should be disabled with Natural Regen off. This can be easily disabled in the config, but it should be disabled by default

issues.title: Scythe does not detect MFR rubber tree leaves
issues.body: Using a scythe on Minefactory Reloaded rubber tree leaves has the same speed as fists.

issues.title: Putting Spring Water in Buildcraft Tank causes crash
issues.body:
When you try to put a bucket of spring water in a [Buildcraft Tank](http://tekkitwiki.com/wiki/Tank), it will cause anyone who loads the chunk containing the tank with spring water to instantly crash.

This is especially annoying in a server setting, where people can "grief" each other by placing spring water in their tank. I am then forced to use HawkEye to remove any tank blocks to stop people from crashing.

Unleashed 1.0.3

issues.title: Spring water drag is inverted.
issues.body:
The current drag on spring water is inverted.

Reproduce:
1) place a spring water source block near a ledge so the water runs in that direction only (closest).
2) stand on the source block.

You SHOULD be pushed towards the ledge, but you are pushed in the opposite direction.

Im using the 152ngt pack. (enabled the mod manually)

issues.title: Plants sometimes spawn on invalid positions
issues.body:
For generating plants such as the Barley in the Pasture biome you are using The vanilla TallGrass Worldgen. However, when that worldgen checks whether a plant block can stay ( canBlockStay() ), it only checks for the block ID, but NOT for the metadata.
Since you're using the same block ID for plants that need sand and plants that need grass blocks to grow, it thinks that the Barley can stay on Sand blocks.

I tried some ways to fix this problem but still without success :/

issues.title: Skycolor config option bug
Dedicated Server calling client only class
issues.body:
Starting with the "Finished Alters" commit: 1d013451f8cd7a745ecb5429c0b4353bd8219505  BOP can no longer be run on a dedicated server.

I tracked the issue to the itemInteractionForEntity function in both ItemSoulManipulator.java and ItemBOP.java.  For the context of this routine on a dedicated server, Minecraft.getMinecraft().thePlayer is invalid, as it is of type EntityClientPlayerMP.  A client class file that does not exist in the server jar.

I am unsure as to a possible workaround at this moment.

issues.title: Some Kelp Issues
issues.body:
1. Can not be placed on any block that is underwater except dirt. Seems unnecessarily restrictive.
2. Sometimes, when placed underwater passages in close quarters to walls and ceilings, the kelp will pop off the ground randomly and when you place other kelp nearby. this was see in a 2 high 2 wide underwater passage.
3. Requested Feature : Placing Kelp on top of kelp to increase its height. (Think Tall Grass)
